68  +
69  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True)
70  + class BonusOffer:
71  +     """What the bot may offer a buyer before it issues an invoice.
72  +
73  +     ``available`` is false whenever bonuses must not be offered at all — the
74  +     programme is off, the balance is empty, or this is the buyer's first
75  +     purchase under a referral, where the discount applies instead.
76  +     """
77  +
78  +     available: bool = False
79  +     balance: int = 0
80  +     units: int = 0
81  +     quote_with_bonus: PriceQuote | None = None
82  +     quote_without_bonus: PriceQuote
83  +
84  +
85  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
86  + class BonusService:
87  +     """Prices checkouts, holds bonus units, and credits inviters."""
88  +
89  +     uow_factory: UnitOfWorkFactory
90  +     locks: LockManager
91  +     settings: ReferralSettings
92  +     notifier: RewardNotifier | None = None
93  +
94  +     @property
95  +     def policy(self) -> BonusPolicy:
96  +         """The configured numbers as a domain value object."""
97  +         return BonusPolicy.from_settings(self.settings)
98  +
99  +     @property
100 +     def discount_percent(self) -> int:
101 +         """Referral discount this shop gives, as a percentage."""
102 +         return self.settings.discount_percent if self.settings.enabled else 0
103 +
104 +     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pricing
105 +
106 +     async def resolve(  # noqa: PLR0913 — one checkout, this many pricing facts
107 +         self,
108 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
109 +         *,
110 +         user_id: int,
111 +         base_amount: Decimal,
112 +         currency: Currency,
113 +         use_bonus: bool,
114 +         stars_per_usdt: Decimal | None = None,
115 +     ) -> PriceQuote:
116 +         """Price a checkout and hold whatever funds it, in the caller's transaction.
117 +
118 +         A bonus is a Star, so on a USDT sale it is valued at the product's own
119 +         ``stars_per_usdt`` rate. A USDT product that declares no rate — it is
120 +         priced in dollars only — cannot express what a bonus is worth, so
121 +         spending bonuses on it is refused rather than guessed.
122 +
123 +         Raises:
124 +             InsufficientBonusBalanceError: the buyer asked to spend bonuses they
125 +                 no longer have. Refusing is deliberate: silently charging the
126 +                 full price would surprise somebody who just saw a lower one.
127 +             BonusesNotAvailableError: bonuses were requested on a USDT product
128 +                 with no declared Stars/USDT equivalence to value them.
129 +         """
130 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
131 +             return plain_quote(base_amount, currency)
132 +
133 +         if (
134 +             use_bonus
135 +             and currency is not Currency.XTR
136 +             and (stars_per_usdt is None or stars_per_usdt <= 0)
137 +         ):
138 +             # A USDT product priced in dollars only has no declared equivalence
139 +             # to value a bonus with. The bot never offers the choice there, so
140 +             # reaching this is a hand-crafted callback — refuse it rather than
141 +             # quietly charge the full price.
142 +             raise BonusesNotAvailableError(user_id=user_id, currency=currency.value)
143 +
144 +         referral = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(user_id)
145 +
146 +         # Two-phase discount check.  The first read is unlocked: it is wrong
147 +         # roughly once per million requests and then only by answering "maybe".
148 +         # The row lock is taken only when that answer is "maybe", so every
149 +         # non-referred buyer, and every buyer who already used the discount,
150 +         # never contends on the lock at all.
151 +         if (
152 +             referral is not None
153 +             and referral.discount_available
154 +             and self.settings.discount_percent > 0
155 +         ):
156 +             referral = await uow.referrals.lock_for_discount_check(user_id)
157 +
158 +         discount_eligible = await self._discount_eligible(uow, user_id, referral=referral)
159 +
160 +         balance = 0
161 +         if use_bonus and not discount_eligible:
162 +             # Row locked: two checkouts started at the same instant cannot both
163 +             # be told the same units are free.
164 +             balance = await uow.bonuses.lock_balance(user_id)
165 +
166 +         priced = quote(
167 +             base_amount,
168 +             currency,
169 +             policy=self.policy,
170 +             referral_id=referral.id if referral is not None else None,
171 +             discount_eligible=discount_eligible,
172 +             balance=balance,
173 +             use_bonus=use_bonus and not discount_eligible,
174 +             stars_per_usdt=stars_per_usdt,
175 +         )
176 +
177 +         if use_bonus and not discount_eligible and not priced.uses_bonus:
178 +             raise InsufficientBonusBalanceError(user_id=user_id, balance=balance)
179 +         return priced
180 +
181 +     async def preview(
182 +         self,
183 +         *,
184 +         user_id: int,
185 +         base_amount: Decimal,
186 +         currency: Currency,
187 +         use_bonus: bool,
188 +         stars_per_usdt: Decimal | None = None,
189 +     ) -> PriceQuote:
190 +         """Price a checkout without holding anything. Read only."""
191 +         offer = await self.offer_for(
192 +             user_id=user_id,
193 +             base_amount=base_amount,
194 +             currency=currency,
195 +             stars_per_usdt=stars_per_usdt,
196 +         )
197 +         if use_bonus and offer.available and offer.quote_with_bonus is not None:
198 +             return offer.quote_with_bonus
199 +         return offer.quote_without_bonus
200 +
201 +     async def discount_eligible(self, uow: UnitOfWork, user_id: int) -> bool:
202 +         """Whether this buyer's next purchase carries the referral discount.
203 +
204 +         Answered from the caller's transaction, which is what lets the product
205 +         card show the reduced price without a second round trip.
206 +         """
207 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
208 +             return False
209 +         referral = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(user_id)
210 +         return await self._discount_eligible(uow, user_id, referral=referral)
211 +
212 +     async def hold_for(self, uow: UnitOfWork, purchase: Purchase, priced: PriceQuote) -> None:
213 +         """Record the reservation behind a purchase that was just created.
214 +
215 +         Separate from ``resolve`` only because the purchase id does not exist
216 +         until the row is inserted; both run in the same transaction.
217 +         """
218 +         if priced.bonus_units <= 0:
219 +             return
220 +
221 +         entry = await uow.bonuses.add(
222 +             BonusTransactionDraft(
223 +                 user_id=purchase.user_id,
224 +                 amount=-priced.bonus_units,
225 +                 type=BonusTransactionType.BONUS_RESERVED,
226 +                 purchase_id=purchase.id,
227 +                 # The rate that valued these units, on a USDT sale — ``None`` on
228 +                 # Stars, where one bonus is one Star. Kept on the reservation so
229 +                 # a later release or spend carries the same rate the invoice used.
230 +                 stars_per_usdt=priced.bonus_rate,
231 +             )
232 +         )
233 +         if entry is None:  # pragma: no cover — a fresh purchase id cannot collide
234 +             logger.warning("bonus_hold_already_recorded", purchase_id=str(purchase.id))
235 +             return
236 +         logger.info(
237 +             "bonus_reserved",
238 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
239 +             user_id=purchase.user_id,
240 +             units=priced.bonus_units,
241 +         )
242 +
243 +     async def on_payment_confirmed(self, uow: UnitOfWork, purchase: Purchase) -> None:
244 +         """Turn the holds behind a paid purchase into settled facts.
245 +
246 +         The referral discount is burned *here* rather than when the invoice was
247 +         issued: an abandoned invoice must not consume the buyer's one discount.
248 +
249 +         If the discount was already consumed by a parallel checkout (Bug #2), the
250 +         payment has already been confirmed by the provider and the money has
251 +         moved.  Crashing the settlement would leave the purchase stuck in
252 +         ``paid`` without delivery, which is worse than honouring a discount that
253 +         leaked through the race window.  We therefore log the anomaly and carry
254 +         on: the race itself is closed by Bug #1's fix below.
255 +         """
256 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
257 +             return
258 +
259 +         await uow.bonuses.settle_hold(purchase.id)
260 +
261 +         if purchase.discount_amount <= 0:
262 +             return
263 +         referral = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(purchase.user_id)
264 +         if referral is None:  # pragma: no cover — a discount implies a referral
265 +             logger.warning("discount_without_referral", purchase_id=str(purchase.id))
266 +             return
267 +         try:
268 +             await uow.referrals.mark_discount_used(referral.id, purchase_id=purchase.id)
269 +         except DiscountAlreadyUsedError:
270 +             # Another purchase already consumed the one-time discount.  This
271 +             # purchase was created with a discount that leaked through the race
272 +             # window; refusing to settle would leave a paid buyer without their
273 +             # link.  Log it and continue — the race itself is prevented at
274 +             # checkout time by the pending-discount guard.
275 +             logger.warning(
276 +                 "discount_already_consumed_by_another_purchase",
277 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
278 +                 referral_id=str(referral.id),
279 +                 discount=str(purchase.discount_amount),
280 +             )
281 +             return
282 +         logger.info(
283 +             "referral_discount_used",
284 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
285 +             referral_id=str(referral.id),
286 +             discount=str(purchase.discount_amount),
287 +         )
288 +
289 +     async def offer_for(
290 +         self,
291 +         *,
292 +         user_id: int,
293 +         base_amount: Decimal,
294 +         currency: Currency,
295 +         stars_per_usdt: Decimal | None = None,
296 +     ) -> BonusOffer:
297 +         """Price both branches so the bot can ask "spend your bonuses?".
298 +
299 +         Read only: nothing is held until a button is actually pressed.
300 +
301 +         ``quote_without_bonus`` is the price the buyer is actually charged when
302 +         they do not spend bonuses, **including the referral discount**, on
303 +         either rail. That matters beyond the prompt: ``preview`` reads this
304 +         quote, and ``preview`` is what bills the CryptoBot invoice before the
305 +         purchase row exists. Leaving the discount out here once made every
306 +         discounted crypto checkout fail — the invoice was raised at the list
307 +         price and ``start_purchase`` then refused the mismatch.
308 +         """
309 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
310 +             return BonusOffer(quote_without_bonus=plain_quote(base_amount, currency))
311 +
312 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
313 +             referral = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(user_id)
314 +             discount_eligible = await self._discount_eligible(uow, user_id, referral=referral)
315 +             balance = await uow.bonuses.balance(user_id)
316 +
317 +         referral_id = referral.id if referral is not None else None
318 +         without = quote(
319 +             base_amount,
320 +             currency,
321 +             policy=self.policy,
322 +             referral_id=referral_id,
323 +             discount_eligible=discount_eligible,
324 +         )
325 +         # On a first referral purchase bonuses are not offered at all: the
326 +         # discount applies instead (Referral > Bonus), which keeps the economics
327 +         # simple and removes a family of edge cases. The discount is a
328 +         # percentage of the price, so it stays in ``without`` above on every
329 +         # rail — it is only the *bonus* branch that needs a rate on USDT.
330 +         #
331 +         # A USDT product priced in dollars only has no declared Stars/USDT
332 +         # equivalence to value a bonus with, so none is offered there either.
333 +         no_usdt_rate = currency is not Currency.XTR and (
334 +             stars_per_usdt is None or stars_per_usdt <= 0
335 +         )
336 +         if discount_eligible or balance <= 0 or no_usdt_rate:
337 +             return BonusOffer(balance=balance, quote_without_bonus=without)
338 +
339 +         with_bonus = quote(
340 +             base_amount,
341 +             currency,
342 +             policy=self.policy,
343 +             balance=balance,
344 +             use_bonus=True,
345 +             stars_per_usdt=stars_per_usdt,
346 +         )
347 +         if not with_bonus.uses_bonus:
348 +             return BonusOffer(balance=balance, quote_without_bonus=without)
349 +
350 +         return BonusOffer(
351 +             available=True,
352 +             balance=balance,
353 +             units=with_bonus.bonus_units,
354 +             quote_with_bonus=with_bonus,
355 +             quote_without_bonus=without,
356 +         )
357 +
358 +     async def balance_of(self, user_id: int) -> int:
359 +         """Spendable bonus units of one user."""
360 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
361 +             return await uow.bonuses.balance(user_id)
362 +
363 +     # ------------------------------------------------------------------ rewards
364 +
365 +     async def accrue(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> None:
366 +         """Credit the buyer's inviter for a settled purchase. Never raises.
367 +
368 +         Called right after a sale is marked delivered. Failure is contained: the
369 +         buyer already has their link, and housekeeping repairs the ledger.
370 +         """
371 +         await self.accrue_once(purchase_id)
372 +
373 +     async def accrue_once(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> bool:
374 +         """Credit the inviter and report whether this call was the one that did.
375 +
376 +         Returns ``False`` for "nothing to do" as well as for failure, which are
377 +         the same thing to a caller that only needs to know if it made progress.
378 +         """
379 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
380 +             return False
381 +         try:
382 +             notice = await self._accrue(purchase_id)
383 +         except AppError as error:
384 +             logger.error(  # noqa: TRY400 — a ledger hiccup must not fail a delivery
385 +                 "referral_reward_failed",
386 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
387 +                 error=str(error),
388 +             )
389 +             return False
390 +         if notice is None:
391 +             return False
392 +         await self._notify(notice)
393 +         return True
394 +
395 +     async def invite_buyer(self, user_id: int) -> None:
396 +         """Offer the referral programme to somebody who just bought. Never raises.
397 +
398 +         A one-line invitation with a button, not a requirement: the shop works
399 +         exactly the same for a buyer who ignores it forever.
400 +         """
401 +         if not self.settings.enabled or self.notifier is None:
402 +             return
403 +         try:
404 +             await self.notifier.notify_purchase_complete(user_id)
405 +         except Exception as error:
406 +             logger.info("purchase_hint_not_delivered", user_id=user_id, error=str(error))
407 +
408 +     async def accrue_missing(self, *, limit: int = 100) -> int:
409 +         """Credit inviters for delivered sales that carry no reward yet.
410 +
411 +         The safety net for a process that died between marking a sale delivered
412 +         and writing the ledger entry.
413 +         """
414 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
415 +             return 0
416 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
417 +             pending = await uow.bonuses.purchases_awaiting_reward(limit=limit)
418 +
419 +         accrued = 0
420 +         for purchase_id in pending:
421 +             if await self.accrue_once(purchase_id):
422 +                 accrued += 1
423 +         if accrued:
424 +             logger.info("referral_rewards_backfilled", count=accrued)
425 +         return accrued
426 +
427 +     async def release_stale_holds(self, *, limit: int = 100) -> int:
428 +         """Give back bonus units held by invoices that can no longer be paid."""
429 +         if not self.settings.enabled:
430 +             return 0
431 +
432 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
433 +             stale = await uow.bonuses.stale_holds(limit=limit)
434 +
435 +         released = 0
436 +         for purchase_id in stale:
437 +             async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
438 +                 purchase = await uow.purchases.get(purchase_id)
439 +                 if purchase is None:  # pragma: no cover — protected by the FK
440 +                     continue
441 +                 async with self.locks.lock(bonus_lock_key(purchase.user_id)):
442 +                     if await uow.bonuses.release_hold(purchase_id) is not None:
443 +                         released += 1
444 +         if released:
445 +             logger.info("bonus_reserves_released", count=released)
446 +         return released
447 +
448 +     async def _accrue(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> RewardNotice | None:
449 +         """Write the reward entry, or return ``None`` when there is nothing to do."""
450 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
451 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.get(purchase_id)
452 +             if purchase is None:
453 +                 logger.warning("reward_for_unknown_purchase", purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
454 +                 return None
455 +
456 +             # Only a delivered sale earns a reward. A pending, expired, failed
457 +             # or refunded purchase earns nothing, and neither does an invoice.
458 +             if purchase.status is not PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED:
459 +                 return None
460 +
461 +             referral = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(purchase.user_id)
462 +             if referral is None:
463 +                 return None
464 +
465 +             units, rate = await self._reward_for(uow, purchase)
466 +             if units <= 0:
467 +                 return None
468 +
469 +             async with self.locks.lock(bonus_lock_key(referral.referrer_user_id)):
470 +                 entry = await uow.bonuses.add(
471 +                     BonusTransactionDraft(
472 +                         user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
473 +                         amount=units,
474 +                         type=BonusTransactionType.REFERRAL_REWARD,
475 +                         referral_id=referral.id,
476 +                         purchase_id=purchase.id,
477 +                         stars_per_usdt=rate,
478 +                     )
479 +                 )
480 +                 if entry is None:
481 +                     # A replayed notification. The reward exists exactly once.
482 +                     logger.info(
483 +                         "referral_reward_already_credited",
484 +                         purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
485 +                         referrer_user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
486 +                     )
487 +                     return None
488 +                 balance = await uow.bonuses.balance(referral.referrer_user_id)
489 +
490 +         logger.info(
491 +             "referral_reward_credited",
492 +             purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
493 +             referral_id=str(referral.id),
494 +             referrer_user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
495 +             units=units,
496 +             paid_amount=str(purchase.amount),
497 +             currency=purchase.currency.value,
498 +         )
499 +         return RewardNotice(
500 +             user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
501 +             units=units,
502 +             balance=balance,
503 +             paid_amount=purchase.amount,
504 +             currency=purchase.currency,
505 +         )
506 +
507 +     async def _notify(self, notice: RewardNotice) -> None:
508 +         """Tell the inviter, best effort.
509 +
510 +         A notification is a courtesy, never a financial transaction: a blocked
511 +         chat must not undo a credited reward.
512 +         """
513 +         if self.notifier is None:
514 +             return
515 +         try:
516 +             await self.notifier.notify_reward(notice)
517 +         except Exception as error:
518 +             logger.info(
519 +                 "reward_notice_not_delivered",
520 +                 user_id=notice.user_id,
521 +                 error=str(error),
522 +             )
523 +
524 +     async def _reward_for(
525 +         self,
526 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
527 +         purchase: Purchase,
528 +     ) -> tuple[int, Decimal | None]:
529 +         """Bonuses this sale earns its inviter, and the rate used to get there.
530 +
531 +         A Stars sale needs no conversion and carries no rate. A USDT sale is
532 +         expressed in Stars through the rate the *product itself* declares by
533 +         carrying both prices — read here, inside the caller's transaction, and
534 +         stored on the ledger entry so repricing the product later cannot
535 +         recompute an old reward.
536 +
537 +         Returns ``(0, ...)`` for "nothing to credit", which covers a USDT
538 +         product that declares no rate at all.
539 +         """
540 +         rate = await self._stars_per_usdt(uow, purchase)
541 +         if purchase.currency is not Currency.XTR and rate is None:
542 +             logger.warning(
543 +                 "reward_without_declared_rate",
544 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
545 +                 product_id=str(purchase.product_id),
546 +                 currency=purchase.currency.value,
547 +             )
548 +             return 0, None
549 +
550 +         units = reward_bonuses(
551 +             purchase.amount,
552 +             purchase.currency,
553 +             policy=self.policy,
554 +             stars_per_usdt=rate,
555 +         )
556 +         if units <= 0:
557 +             logger.info(
558 +                 "referral_reward_below_minimum",
559 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
560 +                 amount=str(purchase.amount),
561 +                 currency=purchase.currency.value,
562 +             )
563 +         return units, rate
564 +
565 +     @staticmethod
566 +     async def _stars_per_usdt(uow: UnitOfWork, purchase: Purchase) -> Decimal | None:
567 +         """The rate this sale's product declares, or ``None`` for a Stars sale."""
568 +         if purchase.currency is Currency.XTR:
569 +             return None
570 +         product = await uow.products.get(purchase.product_id)
571 +         return None if product is None else product.stars_per_usdt
572 +
573 +     async def _discount_eligible(
574 +         self,
575 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
576 +         user_id: int,
577 +         *,
578 +         referral: Referral | None,
579 +     ) -> bool:
580 +         """Whether the one-time first-purchase discount applies right now.
581 +
582 +         Four questions, all answered from the same transaction: is this buyer
583 +         attributed to somebody, is their one discount still unused, are they
584 +         genuinely a first-time buyer, and is the discount already claimed by an
585 +         in-flight checkout (Bug #1).
586 +         """
587 +         if referral is None or self.settings.discount_percent <= 0:
588 +             return False
589 +         if not referral.discount_available:
590 +             return False
591 +         if await uow.purchases.has_history(
592 +             user_id,
593 +             statuses=PURCHASE_HISTORY_STATUSES,
594 +         ):
595 +             return False
596 +         # A concurrent checkout for a *different* product may have already
597 +         # created a pending purchase with this discount.  The purchase lock is
598 +         # per-product, so without this check both checkouts would see the
599 +         # discount as available and create two discounted invoices.
600 +         return not await uow.purchases.has_pending_discount(user_id)
601 +
602 +
603 + __all__ = ["BonusOffer", "BonusService"]

4   +
5   +     **an invoice is created only when the buyer presses a payment button.**
6   +
7   + Opening a product card goes through ``PurchaseService.open_card``, which reads
8   + the product and the buyer's history and writes no purchase and no invoice. Only
9   + ``start_stars_checkout`` / ``start_crypto_checkout`` — reachable exclusively from
10  + a button press — create a ``pending`` purchase and an invoice.
11  +
12  + Settlement is orchestration too, in the mandated order and nothing more:
13  +
14  +     PurchaseService.confirm_payment() → DeliveryService.deliver_purchase()
15  +     (which itself confirms via PurchaseService.mark_delivered())
16  + """

26  + from app.domain.enums import PaymentProvider, PurchaseStatus

37  +     from app.services.delivery import DeliveryService
38  +     from app.services.purchases import PurchaseService

50  +
51  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
52  + class CheckoutService:
53  +     """Turns a pressed payment button into an invoice, and a payment into delivery."""
54  +
55  +     purchases: PurchaseService
56  +     delivery: DeliveryService
57  +     stars: StarsInvoiceSender

60  +     async def start_stars_checkout(
61  +         self,
62  +         *,
63  +         user_id: int,
64  +         product: Product,
65  +         use_bonus: bool = False,
66  +     ) -> Purchase:
67  +         """Create a pending purchase and send the Stars invoice message.
68  +
69  +         The purchase is recorded first: it is local and cheap, and its payload is
70  +         what Telegram echoes back with the payment. If Telegram then refuses to
71  +         send the invoice the purchase simply expires unpaid.
72  +
73  +         The invoice is issued for ``purchase.amount``, which is whatever pricing
74  +         decided inside that transaction — so a discount or a bonus spend can
75  +         never disagree with what the buyer is asked to pay.
76  +
77  +         Raises:
78  +             LockBusyError: the buyer is already checking this product out.
79  +             DuplicatePurchaseError: the buyer already owns the product.
80  +             ProductInactiveError, ProviderNotSupportedError: cannot be sold this way.
81  +             InsufficientBonusBalanceError: bonuses were requested but are gone.
82  +             PaymentGatewayError: Telegram refused to send the invoice.
83  +         """
84  +         payload = uuid4().hex
85  +         purchase = await self.purchases.start_purchase(
86  +             user_id=user_id,
87  +             product_id=product.id,
88  +             provider=PaymentProvider.STARS,
89  +             external_id=payload,
90  +             use_bonus=use_bonus,
91  +         )
92  +         await self.stars.send_invoice(
93  +             InvoiceRequest(
94  +                 user_id=user_id,
95  +                 product_id=product.id,
96  +                 title=product.title,
97  +                 description=product.description,
98  +                 amount=purchase.amount,
99  +                 currency=purchase.currency,
100 +                 payload=payload,
101 +             )
102 +         )
103 +         logger.info(
104 +             "stars_checkout_started",
105 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
106 +             user_id=user_id,
107 +             product_id=str(product.id),
108 +         )
109 +         return purchase
110 +
111 +     async def start_crypto_checkout(
112 +         self,
113 +         *,
114 +         user_id: int,
115 +         product: Product,
116 +         use_bonus: bool = False,
117 +     ) -> CryptoCheckout:
118 +         """Create a CryptoBot invoice and the matching pending purchase.
119 +
120 +         The provider assigns the invoice id that later webhooks are matched on,
121 +         so the invoice must exist first. Ownership is checked before that call so
122 +         a buyer who already owns the product never reaches the provider.
123 +
124 +         Because the invoice comes first, the price is computed twice: once to
125 +         bill the provider, then authoritatively inside the purchase transaction.
126 +         The second computation is handed the first one's number, and refuses the
127 +         purchase if they disagree. That is the safe direction: an unmatched
128 +         CryptoBot invoice expires unpaid, whereas a purchase recorded at a
129 +         different amount than the buyer was shown would be a real defect.
130 +
131 +         Raises:
132 +             LockBusyError: the buyer is already checking this product out.
133 +             DuplicatePurchaseError: the buyer already owns the product.
134 +             ProductInactiveError, ProviderNotSupportedError: cannot be sold this way.
135 +             InsufficientBonusBalanceError: bonuses were requested but are gone.
136 +             ConflictError: the price moved between the invoice and the purchase.
137 +             PaymentGatewayError: Crypto Pay refused or is unreachable.
138 +         """
139 +         if await self.purchases.find_owned(user_id, product.id) is not None:
140 +             raise DuplicatePurchaseError(product_id=str(product.id), user_id=user_id)
141 +
142 +         amount = await self.purchases.quote_amount(
143 +             user_id=user_id,
144 +             product=product,
145 +             provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO,
146 +             use_bonus=use_bonus,
147 +         )
148 +         invoice = await self.crypto.create_invoice(
149 +             InvoiceRequest(
150 +                 user_id=user_id,
151 +                 product_id=product.id,
152 +                 title=product.title,
153 +                 description=product.description,
154 +                 amount=amount,
155 +                 currency=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO.currency,
156 +                 payload=uuid4().hex,
157 +             )
158 +         )
159 +         purchase = await self.purchases.start_purchase(
160 +             user_id=user_id,
161 +             product_id=product.id,
162 +             provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO,
163 +             external_id=invoice.external_id,
164 +             use_bonus=use_bonus,
165 +             expected_amount=amount,
166 +         )
167 +         logger.info(
168 +             "crypto_checkout_started",
169 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
170 +             user_id=user_id,
171 +             product_id=str(product.id),
172 +             invoice_id=invoice.external_id,
173 +         )
174 +         return CryptoCheckout(purchase=purchase, pay_url=invoice.pay_url or "")
175 +
176 +     async def settle_payment(
177 +         self,
178 +         *,
179 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
180 +         external_id: str,
181 +         telegram_charge_id: str | None = None,
182 +         paid_at: datetime | None = None,
183 +     ) -> DeliveryResult:
184 +         """Confirm a payment and then deliver, in that order.
185 +
186 +         Idempotent end to end: a replayed notification confirms nothing new and
187 +         delivers nothing twice.
188 +
189 +         Raises:
190 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: the invoice belongs to no purchase.
191 +             LockBusyError: another worker is already settling this payment.
192 +             ConflictError: the purchase was refunded.
193 +         """
194 +         purchase = await self.purchases.confirm_payment(
195 +             provider=provider,
196 +             external_id=external_id,
197 +             telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id,
198 +             paid_at=paid_at,
199 +         )
200 +         return await self.delivery.deliver_purchase(purchase.id)
201 +
202 +     async def redeliver(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> DeliveryResult:
203 +         """Hand the link over again to a buyer who already owns the product."""
204 +         return await self.delivery.redeliver(purchase_id)
205 +
206 +     async def verify_payment(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> VerificationReport:
207 +         """Re-check one purchase against the provider and finish it if needed.
208 +
209 +         Used by the admin panel when a buyer reports a payment without a link.
210 +         Fully idempotent:
211 +
212 +         * already delivered → nothing is sent, nothing changes;
213 +         * paid but undelivered → delivery is retried;
214 +         * pending → the provider is asked for the truth. CryptoBot is queried
215 +           through its API; Telegram Stars has no lookup endpoint, so the stored
216 +           charge id is used — its presence is Telegram's own confirmation that
217 +           the payment happened;
218 +         * refunded or genuinely unpaid → reported, never "fixed".
219 +
220 +         Raises:
221 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase with this id.
222 +             LockBusyError: a payment or delivery for it is being processed.
223 +         """
224 +         purchase = await self.purchases.get(purchase_id)
225 +         status_before = purchase.status
226 +
227 +         if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.REFUNDED:
228 +             return self._report(purchase, VerificationOutcome.REFUNDED, status_before)
229 +
230 +         if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED:
231 +             return self._report(purchase, VerificationOutcome.ALREADY_DELIVERED, status_before)
232 +
233 +         if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.PAID:
234 +             # The money is in; only the hand-over is missing.
235 +             result = await self.delivery.deliver_purchase(purchase_id)
236 +             outcome = (
237 +                 VerificationOutcome.DELIVERED_NOW
238 +                 if result.succeeded
239 +                 else VerificationOutcome.DELIVERY_FAILED
240 +             )
241 +             refreshed = await self.purchases.get(purchase_id)
242 +             return self._report(refreshed, outcome, status_before, delivery=result)
243 +
244 +         if purchase.provider is PaymentProvider.STARS:
245 +             return await self._verify_stars(purchase, status_before)
246 +         return await self._verify_crypto(purchase, status_before)
247 +
248 +     async def _verify_stars(
249 +         self,
250 +         purchase: Purchase,
251 +         status_before: PurchaseStatus,
252 +     ) -> VerificationReport:
253 +         """Stars has no invoice lookup: the stored charge id is the evidence."""
254 +         if not purchase.telegram_charge_id:
255 +             return self._report(
256 +                 purchase,
257 +                 VerificationOutcome.NO_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE,
258 +                 status_before,
259 +                 detail=(
260 +                     "Telegram Stars provides no invoice lookup and no charge id was "
261 +                     "recorded for this invoice, so no payment ever reached the bot."
262 +                 ),
263 +             )
264 +         return await self._settle_and_report(
265 +             purchase,
266 +             status_before,
267 +             telegram_charge_id=purchase.telegram_charge_id,
268 +             provider_state=PaymentState.PAID,
269 +         )
270 +
271 +     async def _verify_crypto(
272 +         self,
273 +         purchase: Purchase,
274 +         status_before: PurchaseStatus,
275 +     ) -> VerificationReport:
276 +         """Ask Crypto Pay what really happened to this invoice."""
277 +         try:
278 +             states = await self.crypto.fetch_states([purchase.external_id])
279 +         except AppError as error:
280 +             logger.warning(
281 +                 "verification_provider_unavailable",
282 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
283 +                 error=str(error),
284 +             )
285 +             return self._report(
286 +                 purchase,
287 +                 VerificationOutcome.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
288 +                 status_before,
289 +                 detail=str(error),
290 +             )
291 +
292 +         state = states.get(purchase.external_id)
293 +         if state is PaymentState.PAID:
294 +             return await self._settle_and_report(
295 +                 purchase,
296 +                 status_before,
297 +                 provider_state=state,
298 +             )
299 +         if state is PaymentState.EXPIRED:
300 +             return self._report(
301 +                 purchase,
302 +                 VerificationOutcome.EXPIRED_UNPAID,
303 +                 status_before,
304 +                 provider_state=state,
305 +             )
306 +         return self._report(
307 +             purchase,
308 +             VerificationOutcome.STILL_UNPAID,
309 +             status_before,
310 +             provider_state=state,
311 +             detail=None if state else "The provider does not know this invoice any more.",
312 +         )
313 +
314 +     async def _settle_and_report(
315 +         self,
316 +         purchase: Purchase,
317 +         status_before: PurchaseStatus,
318 +         *,
319 +         provider_state: PaymentState,
320 +         telegram_charge_id: str | None = None,
321 +     ) -> VerificationReport:
322 +         """Confirm the payment we had missed, then deliver."""
323 +         result = await self.settle_payment(
324 +             provider=purchase.provider,
325 +             external_id=purchase.external_id,
326 +             telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id,
327 +         )
328 +         outcome = (
329 +             VerificationOutcome.SETTLED_AND_DELIVERED
330 +             if result.succeeded
331 +             else VerificationOutcome.DELIVERY_FAILED
332 +         )
333 +         refreshed = await self.purchases.get(purchase.id)
334 +         logger.info(
335 +             "purchase_verified",
336 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
337 +             provider=purchase.provider.value,
338 +             outcome=outcome.value,
339 +             status_before=status_before.value,
340 +             status_after=refreshed.status.value,
341 +         )
342 +         return self._report(
343 +             refreshed,
344 +             outcome,
345 +             status_before,
346 +             provider_state=provider_state,
347 +             delivery=result,
348 +         )
349 +
350 +     @staticmethod
351 +     def _report(  # noqa: PLR0913 — a report simply has this many fields
352 +         purchase: Purchase,
353 +         outcome: VerificationOutcome,
354 +         status_before: PurchaseStatus,
355 +         *,
356 +         provider_state: PaymentState | None = None,
357 +         delivery: DeliveryResult | None = None,
358 +         detail: str | None = None,
359 +     ) -> VerificationReport:
360 +         return VerificationReport(
361 +             purchase_id=purchase.id,
362 +             provider=purchase.provider,
363 +             outcome=outcome,
364 +             status_before=status_before,
365 +             status_after=purchase.status,
366 +             provider_state=provider_state,
367 +             delivery=delivery,
368 +             detail=detail,
369 +         )

1   + """Delivery use cases.
2   +
3   + The only component allowed to put a message in front of the buyer. It owns:
4   +
5   + * sending the purchased link;
6   + * retrying transient transport failures with exponential back-off and jitter;
7   + * logging every delivery outcome;
8   + * confirming the delivery through ``PurchaseService.mark_delivered``.
9   +
10  + Business rules about the purchase itself stay in ``PurchaseService``. The flow is
11  +
12  +     payment confirmed
13  +         → PurchaseService.confirm_payment()
14  +         → DeliveryService.deliver_purchase()
15  +         → PurchaseService.mark_delivered()
16  +
17  + A failed delivery deliberately leaves the purchase in ``paid``: the buyer keeps
18  + the right to the link, and the next ``/start`` (or a re-delivery) hands it over.
19  + No transaction is held open while the transport is being awaited.
20  + """
21  +
22  + from __future__ import annotations
23  +
24  + import asyncio
25  + import random
26  + from dataclasses import dataclass, field
27  + from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
28  +
29  + from app.core.exceptions import (
30  +     ConflictError,
31  +     DeliveryPermanentError,
32  +     DeliveryTransientError,
33  +     ProductNotFoundError,
34  +     PurchaseNotFoundError,
35  +     UserNotFoundError,
36  + )
37  + from app.core.logging import get_logger
38  + from app.domain.delivery import DeliveryMessage, DeliveryResult, DeliveryStatus
39  + from app.domain.enums import PurchaseStatus
40  + from app.domain.locks import delivery_lock_key
41  +
42  + if TYPE_CHECKING:
43  +     from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
44  +     from uuid import UUID
45  +
46  +     from app.core.config import DeliverySettings
47  +     from app.domain.bonuses import SaleCompletion
48  +     from app.domain.delivery import DeliveryGateway
49  +     from app.domain.entities import Product, Purchase, User
50  +     from app.domain.locks import LockManager
51  +     from app.domain.uow import UnitOfWorkFactory
52  +     from app.services.purchases import PurchaseService
53  +
54  + logger = get_logger(__name__)
55  +
56  +
57  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
58  + class _DeliveryContext:
59  +     """Everything needed for one delivery, read in a single short transaction."""
60  +
61  +     purchase: Purchase
62  +     product: Product
63  +     user: User
64  +
65  +
66  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
67  + class DeliveryService:
68  +     """Hands the purchased link to the buyer, reliably."""
69  +
70  +     uow_factory: UnitOfWorkFactory
71  +     purchases: PurchaseService
72  +     gateway: DeliveryGateway
73  +     locks: LockManager
74  +     settings: DeliverySettings
75  +     # Injected so tests can exercise the retry policy without real waiting.
76  +     # slots=True keeps these as instance attributes, so they are plain callables
77  +     # rather than bound methods.
78  +     sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None]] = field(default=asyncio.sleep)
79  +     jitter: Callable[[], float] = field(default=random.random)
80  +     sale_completion: SaleCompletion | None = None
81  +     """Optional referral reward accrual, invoked once a sale is complete.
82  +
83  +     Deliberately last in the sequence and deliberately unable to fail the
84  +     delivery: the buyer's link is the promise this service exists to keep, and
85  +     a bonus ledger hiccup must not break it. Housekeeping repairs what is
86  +     missed, exactly as reconciliation repairs a lost payment webhook.
87  +     """
88  +
89  +     async def deliver_purchase(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> DeliveryResult:
90  +         """Deliver a freshly paid purchase.
91  +
92  +         Returns:
93  +             The outcome. ``ALREADY_DELIVERED`` when a previous attempt succeeded,
94  +             ``FAILED`` when every retry was spent — never an exception for a
95  +             transport problem, so the caller can acknowledge the payment webhook.
96  +
97  +         Raises:
98  +             LockBusyError: another worker is delivering this purchase right now.
99  +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase with this id.
100 +             ConflictError: the purchase is not paid.
101 +         """
102 +         return await self._deliver(purchase_id, is_repeat=False, resend_if_delivered=False)
103 +
104 +     async def redeliver(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> DeliveryResult:
105 +         """Send the link again to a buyer who already owns the product.
106 +
107 +         Used by the repeat-purchase path: the deep link is opened a second time,
108 +         so the buyer gets the *current* link without paying again.
109 +         """
110 +         return await self._deliver(purchase_id, is_repeat=True, resend_if_delivered=True)
111 +
112 +     async def _deliver(
113 +         self,
114 +         purchase_id: UUID,
115 +         *,
116 +         is_repeat: bool,
117 +         resend_if_delivered: bool,
118 +     ) -> DeliveryResult:
119 +         async with self.locks.lock(delivery_lock_key(purchase_id)):
120 +             context = await self._load_context(purchase_id)
121 +             purchase = context.purchase
122 +
123 +             if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED and not resend_if_delivered:
124 +                 logger.info("delivery_skipped_already_delivered", purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
125 +                 return DeliveryResult(
126 +                     status=DeliveryStatus.ALREADY_DELIVERED,
127 +                     purchase_id=purchase_id,
128 +                 )
129 +
130 +             if not purchase.grants_access:
131 +                 message = "Only a paid purchase can be delivered"
132 +                 raise ConflictError(
133 +                     message,
134 +                     purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
135 +                     status=purchase.status.value,
136 +                 )
137 +
138 +             # The buyer always receives the link the product carries right now,
139 +             # even if the admin rotated it after the sale.
140 +             delivery_url = context.product.delivery_url
141 +             outcome = await self._send_with_retries(
142 +                 DeliveryMessage(
143 +                     chat_id=context.user.telegram_id,
144 +                     purchase_id=purchase_id,
145 +                     product_title=context.product.title,
146 +                     delivery_url=delivery_url,
147 +                     is_repeat=is_repeat,
148 +                 ),
149 +             )
150 +             if not outcome.succeeded:
151 +                 return outcome
152 +
153 +             newly_delivered = purchase.status is not PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED
154 +             if newly_delivered:
155 +                 await self.purchases.mark_delivered(purchase_id, delivered_url=delivery_url)
156 +
157 +         logger.info(
158 +             "delivery_completed",
159 +             purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
160 +             attempts=outcome.attempts,
161 +             is_repeat=is_repeat,
162 +         )
163 +         if newly_delivered:
164 +             # Only the transition into "delivered" completes a sale — a
165 +             # re-delivery of something the buyer already owns must not pay a
166 +             # reward twice, nor pester them a second time.
167 +             await self._complete_sale(purchase_id, context.user.telegram_id)
168 +         return outcome
169 +
170 +     async def _complete_sale(self, purchase_id: UUID, user_id: int) -> None:
171 +         """Report a completed sale to the bonus feature. Never raises.
172 +
173 +         Deliberately after the delivery and deliberately unable to break it: the
174 +         buyer's link is the promise this service exists to keep.
175 +         """
176 +         if self.sale_completion is None:
177 +             return
178 +         try:
179 +             await self.sale_completion.accrue(purchase_id)
180 +             await self.sale_completion.invite_buyer(user_id)
181 +         except Exception as error:
182 +             logger.error(  # noqa: TRY400 — a bonus problem is not a delivery failure
183 +                 "sale_completion_not_reported",
184 +                 purchase_id=str(purchase_id),
185 +                 error=str(error),
186 +             )
187 +
188 +     async def _load_context(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> _DeliveryContext:
189 +         """Read the purchase, product and buyer, then close the transaction."""
190 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
191 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.get(purchase_id)
192 +             if purchase is None:
193 +                 raise PurchaseNotFoundError(purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
194 +             product = await uow.products.get(purchase.product_id)
195 +             if product is None:  # pragma: no cover — protected by ON DELETE RESTRICT
196 +                 raise ProductNotFoundError(product_id=str(purchase.product_id))
197 +             user = await uow.users.get(purchase.user_id)
198 +             if user is None:  # pragma: no cover — protected by the foreign key
199 +                 raise UserNotFoundError(telegram_id=purchase.user_id)
200 +         return _DeliveryContext(purchase=purchase, product=product, user=user)
201 +
202 +     async def _send_with_retries(self, message: DeliveryMessage) -> DeliveryResult:
203 +         """Send the message, retrying transient failures with back-off."""
204 +         last_error: str | None = None
205 +
206 +         for attempt in range(1, self.settings.max_attempts + 1):
207 +             try:
208 +                 await self.gateway.send(message)
209 +             except DeliveryPermanentError as error:
210 +                 logger.error(  # noqa: TRY400 — a refusing chat is an outcome, not a crash
211 +                     "delivery_permanently_failed",
212 +                     purchase_id=str(message.purchase_id),
213 +                     chat_id=message.chat_id,
214 +                     attempt=attempt,
215 +                     error=str(error),
216 +                 )
217 +                 return DeliveryResult(
218 +                     status=DeliveryStatus.FAILED,
219 +                     purchase_id=message.purchase_id,
220 +                     attempts=attempt,
221 +                     error=str(error),
222 +                 )
223 +             except DeliveryTransientError as error:
224 +                 last_error = str(error)
225 +                 remaining = self.settings.max_attempts - attempt
226 +                 logger.warning(
227 +                     "delivery_attempt_failed",
228 +                     purchase_id=str(message.purchase_id),
229 +                     chat_id=message.chat_id,
230 +                     attempt=attempt,
231 +                     attempts_left=remaining,
232 +                     retry_after=error.retry_after,
233 +                     error=last_error,
234 +                 )
235 +                 if remaining == 0:
236 +                     break
237 +                 await self.sleep(self._backoff(attempt, error.retry_after))
238 +             else:
239 +                 logger.info(
240 +                     "delivery_sent",
241 +                     purchase_id=str(message.purchase_id),
242 +                     chat_id=message.chat_id,
243 +                     attempt=attempt,
244 +                     is_repeat=message.is_repeat,
245 +                 )
246 +                 return DeliveryResult(
247 +                     status=DeliveryStatus.SENT,
248 +                     purchase_id=message.purchase_id,
249 +                     attempts=attempt,
250 +                 )
251 +
252 +         logger.error(
253 +             "delivery_exhausted",
254 +             purchase_id=str(message.purchase_id),
255 +             chat_id=message.chat_id,
256 +             attempts=self.settings.max_attempts,
257 +             error=last_error,
258 +         )
259 +         return DeliveryResult(
260 +             status=DeliveryStatus.FAILED,
261 +             purchase_id=message.purchase_id,
262 +             attempts=self.settings.max_attempts,
263 +             error=last_error,
264 +         )
265 +
266 +     def _backoff(self, attempt: int, retry_after: float | None) -> float:
267 +         """Exponential back-off, jittered, never shorter than the provider's hint."""
268 +         delay = self.settings.initial_backoff_seconds * (
269 +             self.settings.backoff_multiplier ** (attempt - 1)
270 +         )
271 +         delay = min(delay, self.settings.max_backoff_seconds)
272 +         spread = delay * self.settings.jitter_ratio
273 +         # jitter() ∈ [0, 1) → symmetric jitter around the nominal delay.
274 +         delay = max(0.0, delay + spread * (self.jitter() * 2 - 1))
275 +         if retry_after is not None:
276 +             delay = max(delay, retry_after)
277 +         return delay

1   + """Purchase use cases.
2   +
3   + This service owns the purchase lifecycle only: creating purchases, confirming
4   + payments, moving statuses and answering "does this buyer already own it?".
5   + It never sends a message — handing the link to the buyer belongs to
6   + ``DeliveryService``.
7   + """
8   +
9   + from __future__ import annotations
10  +
11  + from dataclasses import dataclass
12  + from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
13  + from decimal import Decimal
14  + from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
15  +
16  + from app.core.exceptions import (
17  +     ConflictError,
18  +     DuplicatePurchaseError,
19  +     ProductInactiveError,
20  +     ProductNotFoundError,
21  +     ProviderNotSupportedError,
22  +     PurchaseNotFoundError,
23  +     UserNotFoundError,
24  + )
25  + from app.core.logging import get_logger
26  + from app.domain.bonuses import BonusPolicy, discount_for, plain_quote
27  + from app.domain.cards import PaymentOption, ProductCard
28  + from app.domain.commands import PurchaseDraft
29  + from app.domain.locks import payment_lock_key, purchase_lock_key
30  +
31  + if TYPE_CHECKING:
32  +     from uuid import UUID
33  +
34  +     from app.domain.bonuses import CheckoutPricing, PriceQuote
35  +     from app.domain.commands import UserDraft
36  +     from app.domain.entities import Product, Purchase, User
37  +     from app.domain.enums import Currency, PaymentProvider
38  +     from app.domain.locks import LockManager
39  +     from app.domain.uow import UnitOfWork, UnitOfWorkFactory
40  +
41  + logger = get_logger(__name__)
42  +
43  + PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_WAIT_SECONDS = 5.0
44  + """Money already moved: wait for a busy lock instead of dropping the callback."""
45  +
46  +
47  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
48  + class PurchaseService:
49  +     """Business rules of buying exactly one product through one rail."""
50  +
51  +     uow_factory: UnitOfWorkFactory
52  +     locks: LockManager
53  +     invoice_ttl: timedelta = timedelta(minutes=30)
54  +     pricing: CheckoutPricing | None = None
55  +     """Optional referral/bonus pricing.
56  +
57  +     ``None`` is the shop as it was before the referral feature existed: the
58  +     list price is charged, nothing is held and nothing is recorded. Everything
59  +     below therefore has exactly one extra branch, and the default path through
60  +     it is byte for byte the old behaviour.
61  +     """
62  +
63  +     async def open_card(self, profile: UserDraft, slug: str) -> ProductCard:
64  +         """Resolve a deep link into a card, remembering the visitor.
65  +
66  +         Raises:
67  +             ProductNotFoundError: the slug belongs to no product.
68  +             ProductInactiveError: the product exists but is not on sale.
69  +         """
70  +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
71  +             await uow.users.upsert(profile)
72  +             product = await uow.products.get_by_slug(slug)
73  +             if product is None:
74  +                 raise ProductNotFoundError(slug=slug)
75  +             if not product.is_active:
76  +                 raise ProductInactiveError(slug=slug)
77  +             owned = await uow.purchases.find_access_granting(profile.telegram_id, product.id)
78  +             # Asked in the same transaction the card already opened, so showing
79  +             # the reduced price costs no extra round trip. Returns False for
80  +             # every ordinary visitor, and instantly when the feature is off.
81  +             discounted = owned is None and await self._discount_eligible(
82  +                 uow,
83  +                 profile.telegram_id,
84  +             )
85  +
86  +         percent = self.discount_percent if discounted else 0
87  +         options = tuple(
88  +             self._payment_option(product, provider, discount_percent=percent)
89  +             for provider in product.available_providers
90  +         )
91  +         logger.info(
92  +             "card_opened",
93  +             telegram_id=profile.telegram_id,
94  +             slug=slug,
95  +             owned=owned is not None,
96  +             discounted=discounted,
97  +         )
98  +         return ProductCard(
99  +             product=product,
100 +             options=options,
101 +             owned_purchase=owned,
102 +             discount_percent=percent,
103 +         )
104 +
105 +     @property
106 +     def discount_percent(self) -> int:
107 +         """Referral discount the shop is configured to give, as a percentage."""
108 +         return 0 if self.pricing is None else self.pricing.discount_percent
109 +
110 +     async def _discount_eligible(self, uow: UnitOfWork, user_id: int) -> bool:
111 +         """Whether this visitor's next purchase carries the referral discount."""
112 +         if self.pricing is None:
113 +             return False
114 +         return await self.pricing.discount_eligible(uow, user_id)
115 +
116 +     def _payment_option(
117 +         self,
118 +         product: Product,
119 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
120 +         *,
121 +         discount_percent: int,
122 +     ) -> PaymentOption:
123 +         """One button, with the reduced price attached when one applies.
124 +
125 +         ``amount`` stays the list price whatever happens: the discount is a
126 +         property of this visitor's next sale, not of the catalogue.
127 +         """
128 +         listed = self._price(product, provider)
129 +         if discount_percent <= 0:
130 +             return PaymentOption(
131 +                 provider=provider,
132 +                 amount=listed,
133 +                 currency=provider.currency,
134 +             )
135 +         policy = BonusPolicy(discount_percent=discount_percent)
136 +         discount = discount_for(Decimal(listed), provider.currency, policy)
137 +         return PaymentOption(
138 +             provider=provider,
139 +             amount=listed,
140 +             currency=provider.currency,
141 +             discounted_amount=Decimal(listed) - discount if discount > 0 else None,
142 +         )
143 +
144 +     async def remember_user(self, profile: UserDraft) -> User:
145 +         """Store or refresh the Telegram profile snapshot."""
146 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
147 +             return await uow.users.upsert(profile)
148 +
149 +     async def start_purchase(  # noqa: PLR0913 — one checkout, this many facts
150 +         self,
151 +         *,
152 +         user_id: int,
153 +         product_id: UUID,
154 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
155 +         external_id: str,
156 +         use_bonus: bool = False,
157 +         expected_amount: Decimal | None = None,
158 +     ) -> Purchase:
159 +         """Record a pending purchase for an invoice that was just created.
160 +
161 +         The distributed lock (bounded by its TTL) keeps two simultaneous
162 +         ``/start`` presses from producing two invoices for the same product.
163 +
164 +         Pricing runs inside this transaction, not before it. That is the whole
165 +         reason the referral feature cannot mis-bill anybody: the discount, the
166 +         bonus reservation and the purchase row are one commit.
167 +
168 +         ``expected_amount`` is for the rails that must create the provider
169 +         invoice *first* (CryptoBot assigns the id the webhook is matched on). If
170 +         the price computed here disagrees with the amount already invoiced, the
171 +         purchase is refused rather than recorded at a different number, and the
172 +         orphaned invoice simply expires unpaid.
173 +
174 +         Raises:
175 +             LockBusyError: another attempt for this buyer and product is running.
176 +             ProductNotFoundError, ProductInactiveError: product unavailable.
177 +             ProviderNotSupportedError: the product has no price for this rail.
178 +             DuplicatePurchaseError: the buyer already owns the product.
179 +             UserNotFoundError: the buyer was never recorded (the card must be
180 +                 opened first, which is what stores the Telegram profile).
181 +             InsufficientBonusBalanceError: bonuses were requested but the
182 +                 balance moved since the price was shown.
183 +             ConflictError: the price moved away from ``expected_amount``.
184 +         """
185 +         async with (
186 +             self.locks.lock(purchase_lock_key(user_id, product_id)),
187 +             self.uow_factory() as uow,
188 +         ):
189 +             if await uow.users.get(user_id) is None:
190 +                 raise UserNotFoundError(telegram_id=user_id)
191 +             product = await uow.products.get(product_id)
192 +             if product is None:
193 +                 raise ProductNotFoundError(product_id=str(product_id))
194 +             if not product.is_active:
195 +                 raise ProductInactiveError(product_id=str(product_id))
196 +             if not product.supports(provider):
197 +                 raise ProviderNotSupportedError(
198 +                     product_id=str(product_id),
199 +                     provider=provider.value,
200 +                 )
201 +             if await uow.purchases.find_access_granting(user_id, product_id) is not None:
202 +                 raise DuplicatePurchaseError(
203 +                     product_id=str(product_id),
204 +                     user_id=user_id,
205 +                 )
206 +
207 +             base_amount = Decimal(self._price(product, provider))
208 +             priced = await self._price_checkout(
209 +                 uow,
210 +                 user_id=user_id,
211 +                 base_amount=base_amount,
212 +                 currency=provider.currency,
213 +                 use_bonus=use_bonus,
214 +                 stars_per_usdt=product.stars_per_usdt,
215 +             )
216 +             self._require_expected_amount(priced, expected_amount, product_id=product_id)
217 +
218 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.create(
219 +                 PurchaseDraft(
220 +                     user_id=user_id,
221 +                     product_id=product_id,
222 +                     provider=provider,
223 +                     amount=priced.charged_amount,
224 +                     base_amount=priced.base_amount,
225 +                     discount_amount=priced.discount_amount,
226 +                     bonus_amount=priced.bonus_amount,
227 +                     currency=provider.currency,
228 +                     external_id=external_id,
229 +                 )
230 +             )
231 +             if self.pricing is not None:
232 +                 await self.pricing.hold_for(uow, purchase, priced)
233 +
234 +         logger.info(
235 +             "purchase_started",
236 +             purchase_id=str(purchase.id),
237 +             user_id=user_id,
238 +             product_id=str(product_id),
239 +             provider=provider.value,
240 +             external_id=external_id,
241 +             amount=str(purchase.amount),
242 +             discount=str(purchase.discount_amount),
243 +             bonus=str(purchase.bonus_amount),
244 +         )
245 +         return purchase
246 +
247 +     async def _price_checkout(  # noqa: PLR0913 — one checkout, this many pricing facts
248 +         self,
249 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
250 +         *,
251 +         user_id: int,
252 +         base_amount: Decimal,
253 +         currency: Currency,
254 +         use_bonus: bool,
255 +         stars_per_usdt: Decimal | None = None,
256 +     ) -> PriceQuote:
257 +         """The list price, or whatever the referral feature makes of it."""
258 +         if self.pricing is None:
259 +             return plain_quote(base_amount, currency)
260 +         return await self.pricing.resolve(
261 +             uow,
262 +             user_id=user_id,
263 +             base_amount=base_amount,
264 +             currency=currency,
265 +             use_bonus=use_bonus,
266 +             stars_per_usdt=stars_per_usdt,
267 +         )
268 +
269 +     @staticmethod
270 +     def _require_expected_amount(
271 +         priced: PriceQuote,
272 +         expected_amount: Decimal | None,
273 +         *,
274 +         product_id: UUID,
275 +     ) -> None:
276 +         """Refuse to record a purchase at a price other than the invoiced one."""
277 +         if expected_amount is None or priced.charged_amount == expected_amount:
278 +             return
279 +         logger.error(
280 +             "checkout_price_moved",
281 +             product_id=str(product_id),
282 +             invoiced=str(expected_amount),
283 +             recomputed=str(priced.charged_amount),
284 +         )
285 +         message = "The price changed while the invoice was being created"
286 +         raise ConflictError(
287 +             message,
288 +             product_id=str(product_id),
289 +             invoiced=str(expected_amount),
290 +             recomputed=str(priced.charged_amount),
291 +         )
292 +
293 +     async def quote_amount(
294 +         self,
295 +         *,
296 +         user_id: int,
297 +         product: Product,
298 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
299 +         use_bonus: bool = False,
300 +     ) -> Decimal:
301 +         """What this checkout would be billed, without recording anything.
302 +
303 +         Read only, and therefore only a *prediction*: the rails that must create
304 +         the provider invoice before the purchase use it to bill the provider,
305 +         and ``start_purchase`` then re-derives the same number under a lock and
306 +         refuses the sale if they disagree.
307 +         """
308 +         base_amount = Decimal(self._price(product, provider))
309 +         if self.pricing is None:
310 +             return base_amount
311 +         priced = await self.pricing.preview(
312 +             user_id=user_id,
313 +             base_amount=base_amount,
314 +             currency=provider.currency,
315 +             use_bonus=use_bonus,
316 +             stars_per_usdt=product.stars_per_usdt,
317 +         )
318 +         return priced.charged_amount
319 +
320 +     async def confirm_payment(
321 +         self,
322 +         *,
323 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
324 +         external_id: str,
325 +         telegram_charge_id: str | None = None,
326 +         paid_at: datetime | None = None,
327 +     ) -> Purchase:
328 +         """Mark the invoice as paid. Idempotent for replayed notifications.
329 +
330 +         Delivery is deliberately *not* triggered here: the caller passes the
331 +         confirmed purchase to ``DeliveryService``.
332 +
333 +         Raises:
334 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase behind this invoice.
335 +             ConflictError: the purchase was refunded.
336 +             DuplicatePurchaseError: the buyer already owns a paid copy.
337 +         """
338 +         async with (
339 +             self.locks.lock(
340 +                 payment_lock_key(provider, external_id),
341 +                 wait_seconds=PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_WAIT_SECONDS,
342 +             ),
343 +             self.uow_factory() as uow,
344 +         ):
345 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.get_by_external_id(provider, external_id)
346 +             if purchase is None:
347 +                 raise PurchaseNotFoundError(provider=provider.value, external_id=external_id)
348 +             confirmed = await uow.purchases.mark_paid(
349 +                 purchase.id,
350 +                 paid_at=paid_at,
351 +                 telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id,
352 +             )
353 +             if self.pricing is not None:
354 +                 # Same transaction as the payment: the discount is burned and
355 +                 # the bonus reservation becomes a spend exactly once, however
356 +                 # many times the provider replays this notification.
357 +                 await self.pricing.on_payment_confirmed(uow, confirmed)
358 +
359 +         logger.info(
360 +             "payment_confirmed",
361 +             purchase_id=str(confirmed.id),
362 +             provider=provider.value,
363 +             external_id=external_id,
364 +             amount=str(confirmed.amount),
365 +             currency=confirmed.currency.value,
366 +         )
367 +         return confirmed
368 +
369 +     async def mark_delivered(self, purchase_id: UUID, *, delivered_url: str) -> Purchase:
370 +         """Record that the buyer received the link. Called by ``DeliveryService``.
371 +
372 +         Raises:
373 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase with this id.
374 +             ConflictError: the purchase is not paid.
375 +         """
376 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
377 +             delivered = await uow.purchases.mark_delivered(
378 +                 purchase_id,
379 +                 delivered_url=delivered_url,
380 +             )
381 +         logger.info("purchase_delivered", purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
382 +         return delivered
383 +
384 +     async def refund(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> Purchase:
385 +         """Revoke access after a refund. Idempotent.
386 +
387 +         Raises:
388 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase with this id.
389 +         """
390 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
391 +             refunded = await uow.purchases.mark_refunded(purchase_id)
392 +         logger.info("purchase_refunded", purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
393 +         return refunded
394 +
395 +     async def refund_by_charge_id(self, telegram_charge_id: str) -> Purchase:
396 +         """Revoke access using the Telegram charge id from a refund update.
397 +
398 +         Raises:
399 +             PurchaseNotFoundError: no purchase carries this charge id.
400 +         """
401 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
402 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.get_by_charge_id(telegram_charge_id)
403 +             if purchase is None:
404 +                 raise PurchaseNotFoundError(telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id)
405 +             refunded = await uow.purchases.mark_refunded(purchase.id)
406 +         logger.info(
407 +             "purchase_refunded",
408 +             purchase_id=str(refunded.id),
409 +             telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id,
410 +         )
411 +         return refunded

415 +
416 +         Raises:

418 +         """

420 +             purchase = await uow.purchases.get(purchase_id)
421 +         if purchase is None:
422 +             raise PurchaseNotFoundError(purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
423 +         return purchase

427 +
428 +         Raises:

65  +

68  +         """The single hop channel that lists the current preview channels."""

71  +     async def register(
72  +         self,
73  +         *,
74  +         payload: str,
75  +         profile: UserDraft,
76  +     ) -> ReferralRegistration:
77  +         """Attribute the visitor to the owner of this invitation payload.
78  +
79  +         The visitor's Telegram profile is stored first, exactly as opening a
80  +         product card does, so an invited user exists before anything references
81  +         them. Every outcome other than ``LINKED`` leaves the database untouched.
82  +         """
83  +         if not self.enabled:
84  +             return ReferralRegistration(outcome=ReferralOutcome.DISABLED)
85  +         code = parse_referral_payload(payload)
86  +         if code is None:
87  +             return ReferralRegistration(outcome=ReferralOutcome.UNKNOWN_CODE)
88  +

90  +             await uow.users.upsert(profile)
91  +             referrer = await uow.users.get_by_referral_code(code)
92  +             if referrer is None:
93  +                 logger.info("referral_code_unknown", telegram_id=profile.telegram_id)
94  +                 return ReferralRegistration(outcome=ReferralOutcome.UNKNOWN_CODE)
95  +
96  +             refusal = await self._refusal(uow, referrer_id=referrer.telegram_id, profile=profile)
97  +             if refusal is not None:
98  +                 return refusal
99  +             return await self._link(uow, referrer_id=referrer.telegram_id, profile=profile)
100 +
101 +     async def _refusal(
102 +         self,
103 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
104 +         *,
105 +         referrer_id: int,
106 +         profile: UserDraft,
107 +     ) -> ReferralRegistration | None:
108 +         """Why this invitation cannot be accepted, or ``None`` if it can.
109 +
110 +         All three reasons are ordinary user situations, and none of them writes
111 +         anything: opening your own link, opening a second person's link, or
112 +         arriving as somebody who has bought here before.
113 +         """
114 +         if referrer_id == profile.telegram_id:
115 +             logger.info("referral_self_attempt", telegram_id=profile.telegram_id)
116 +             return ReferralRegistration(
117 +                 outcome=ReferralOutcome.SELF_REFERRAL,
118 +                 referrer_user_id=referrer_id,
119 +             )
120 +
121 +         existing = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(profile.telegram_id)
122 +         if existing is not None:
123 +             # Never overwritten: the first inviter keeps the buyer for good.
124 +             logger.info(
125 +                 "referral_already_linked",
126 +                 telegram_id=profile.telegram_id,
127 +                 referrer_user_id=existing.referrer_user_id,
128 +             )
129 +             return ReferralRegistration(
130 +                 outcome=ReferralOutcome.ALREADY_LINKED,
131 +                 referrer_user_id=existing.referrer_user_id,
132 +             )
133 +
134 +         if await self._has_purchase_history(uow, profile.telegram_id):
135 +             # Decided by purchase history, never by how old the Telegram
136 +             # account looks.
137 +             logger.info("referral_not_eligible", telegram_id=profile.telegram_id)
138 +             return ReferralRegistration(
139 +                 outcome=ReferralOutcome.NOT_ELIGIBLE,
140 +                 referrer_user_id=referrer_id,
141 +             )
142 +         return None

144 +     async def _link(
145 +         self,
146 +         uow: UnitOfWork,
147 +         *,
148 +         referrer_id: int,
149 +         profile: UserDraft,
150 +     ) -> ReferralRegistration:
151 +         """Write the relationship, letting the database settle any race."""
152 +         try:
153 +             referral = await uow.referrals.create(
154 +                 ReferralDraft(
155 +                     referrer_user_id=referrer_id,
156 +                     referred_user_id=profile.telegram_id,
157 +                 )
158 +             )
159 +         except ReferralAlreadySetError:
160 +             # Two links opened in the same instant; the database picked one.
161 +             linked = await uow.referrals.get_by_referred(profile.telegram_id)
162 +             return ReferralRegistration(
163 +                 outcome=ReferralOutcome.ALREADY_LINKED,
164 +                 referrer_user_id=linked.referrer_user_id if linked else None,
165 +             )
166 +         except SelfReferralError:  # pragma: no cover — refused before we get here
167 +             return ReferralRegistration(outcome=ReferralOutcome.SELF_REFERRAL)
168 +
169 +         logger.info(
170 +             "referral_linked",
171 +             referral_id=str(referral.id),
172 +             referrer_user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
173 +             referred_user_id=referral.referred_user_id,
174 +         )
175 +         return ReferralRegistration(
176 +             outcome=ReferralOutcome.LINKED,
177 +             referrer_user_id=referral.referrer_user_id,
178 +         )
179 +
180 +     async def summary(self, profile: UserDraft) -> BonusSummary:
181 +         """Everything the "My bonuses" screen shows, minting a code if needed.
182 +
183 +         Raises:
184 +             ConflictError: a fresh code could not be assigned. The caller shows
185 +                 a soft failure; nothing about the shop is affected.
186 +         """
187 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:
188 +             await uow.users.upsert(profile)
189 +             code = await self._ensure_code(uow, profile.telegram_id)
190 +             balance = await uow.bonuses.balance(profile.telegram_id)
191 +             invited = await uow.referrals.count_invited(profile.telegram_id)
192 +             purchases = await uow.referrals.count_referral_purchases(profile.telegram_id)
193 +
194 +         return BonusSummary(
195 +             user_id=profile.telegram_id,
196 +             balance=balance,
197 +             referral_code=code,
198 +             invited_count=invited,
199 +             referral_purchase_count=purchases,
200 +         )
201 +
202 +     def link_for(self, code: str) -> str:
203 +         """Public invitation link for a referral code."""
204 +         return self.telegram.deep_link(referral_payload(code))
205 +
206 +     async def referral_of(self, user_id: int) -> Referral | None:
207 +         """The relationship that owns this buyer, if any."""
208 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:

211 +     async def search(self, filters: ReferralFilters, page: PageRequest) -> Page[ReferralRecord]:
212 +         """Referral relationships for the admin panel. Read only."""
213 +         async with self.uow_factory() as uow:

215 +
216 +     async def _ensure_code(self, uow: UnitOfWork, telegram_id: int) -> str:
217 +         """Return this user's permanent code, retrying past a rare collision."""
218 +         for _ in range(CODE_ASSIGNMENT_ATTEMPTS):
219 +             try:
220 +                 return await uow.users.ensure_referral_code(
221 +                     telegram_id,
222 +                     candidate=generate_referral_code(),
223 +                 )
224 +             except ConflictError:
225 +                 continue
226 +         message = "Could not assign a referral code"
227 +         raise ConflictError(message, telegram_id=telegram_id)
228 +
229 +     @staticmethod
230 +     async def _has_purchase_history(uow: UnitOfWork, telegram_id: int) -> bool:
231 +         """Whether this buyer has ever bought anything.
232 +
233 +         A refunded purchase counts as history on purpose: if it did not, a buyer
234 +         could refund their way back to "new" and harvest the discount again.
235 +         """
236 +         return await uow.purchases.has_history(
237 +             telegram_id,
238 +             statuses=PURCHASE_HISTORY_STATUSES,
239 +         )
