128 +     need their own sessions and real commits, so the tables are truncated instead.
129 +     """
130 +     url = make_url(migrated_database)
131 +     settings = PostgresSettings(
132 +         host=url.host or "127.0.0.1",
133 +         port=url.port or 5432,
134 +         user=url.username or "postgres",
135 +         password=SecretStr(url.password or ""),
136 +         db=url.database or "postgres",
137 +         pool_size=10,
138 +     )
139 +     database = Database(settings)
140 +     await _truncate(database)
141 +     try:
142 +         yield database
143 +     finally:
144 +         await _truncate(database)
145 +         await database.dispose()
146 +

148 + async def _truncate(database: Database) -> None:
149 +     statement = text(f"TRUNCATE {', '.join(TABLES_TO_TRUNCATE)} RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE")
150 +     async with database.engine.begin() as connection:
151 +         await connection.execute(statement)

1   + """In-memory doubles for fast service tests.
2   +
3   + They implement the same repository contracts as the SQLAlchemy versions,
4   + including the rules the database enforces (unique slug, unique invoice, one paid
5   + copy per buyer), so a service test that passes here is not passing by accident.
6   + """
7   +

75  + class FakeProductRepository:
76  +     """Products in a dictionary, with the unique-slug rule enforced."""
77  +
78  +     def __init__(self) -> None:
79  +         self.items: dict[UUID, Product] = {}
80  +         self.purchases: FakePurchaseRepository | None = None
81  +
82  +     async def get(self, product_id: UUID) -> Product | None:
83  +         return self.items.get(product_id)
84  +
85  +     async def get_by_slug(self, slug: str, *, only_active: bool = False) -> Product | None:
86  +         for product in self.items.values():
87  +             if product.slug == slug and (product.is_active or not only_active):
88  +                 return product
89  +         return None
90  +
91  +     async def list_products(self, filters: ProductFilters, page: PageRequest) -> Page[Product]:
92  +         matches = [
93  +             product
94  +             for product in self.items.values()
95  +             if (filters.search is None or filters.search.lower() in product.title.lower())
96  +             and (filters.is_active is None or product.is_active is filters.is_active)
97  +         ]
98  +         matches.sort(key=lambda product: product.created_at, reverse=True)
99  +         window = matches[page.offset : page.offset + page.limit]
100 +         return Page(items=tuple(window), total=len(matches), limit=page.limit, offset=page.offset)
101 +
102 +     async def create(self, draft: ProductDraft) -> Product:
103 +         if await self.get_by_slug(draft.slug) is not None:
104 +             raise SlugAlreadyExistsError(slug=draft.slug)
105 +         product = Product(
106 +             id=uuid4(),
107 +             slug=draft.slug,
108 +             title=draft.title,
109 +             description=draft.description,
110 +             photo_file_id=draft.photo_file_id,
111 +             delivery_url=draft.delivery_url,
112 +             price_stars=draft.price_stars,
113 +             price_usdt=draft.price_usdt,
114 +             is_active=draft.is_active,
115 +             created_at=NOW,
116 +             updated_at=NOW,
117 +         )
118 +         self.items[product.id] = product
119 +         return product
120 +
121 +     async def update(self, product_id: UUID, changes: ProductUpdate) -> Product:
122 +         current = self.items.get(product_id)
123 +         if current is None:
124 +             raise ProductNotFoundError(product_id=str(product_id))
125 +         applied = changes.changes()
126 +         if is_set(changes.slug):
127 +             clash = await self.get_by_slug(changes.slug)
128 +             if clash is not None and clash.id != product_id:
129 +                 raise SlugAlreadyExistsError(slug=changes.slug)
130 +         updated = replace(current, **applied)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
131 +         self.items[product_id] = updated
132 +         return updated
133 +
134 +     async def delete(self, product_id: UUID) -> None:
135 +         if product_id not in self.items:
136 +             raise ProductNotFoundError(product_id=str(product_id))
137 +         if self.purchases is not None and any(
138 +             purchase.product_id == product_id for purchase in self.purchases.items.values()
139 +         ):
140 +             message = "Product has purchases and cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead"
141 +             raise ConflictError(message, product_id=str(product_id))
142 +         del self.items[product_id]
143 +
144 +     async def count(self, *, only_active: bool | None = None) -> int:
145 +         if only_active is None:
146 +             return len(self.items)
147 +         return sum(1 for product in self.items.values() if product.is_active is only_active)
148 +

150 + class FakeUserRepository:
151 +     """Users in a dictionary."""
152 +
153 +     def __init__(self) -> None:
154 +         self.items: dict[int, User] = {}
155 +
156 +     async def get(self, telegram_id: int) -> User | None:
157 +         return self.items.get(telegram_id)
158 +
159 +     async def upsert(self, draft: UserDraft, *, seen_at: datetime | None = None) -> User:
160 +         moment = seen_at or NOW
161 +         existing = self.items.get(draft.telegram_id)
162 +         user = User(
163 +             telegram_id=draft.telegram_id,
164 +             username=draft.username,
165 +             first_name=draft.first_name,
166 +             language_code=draft.language_code,
167 +             created_at=existing.created_at if existing else moment,
168 +             last_seen_at=moment,
169 +             # An upsert refreshes the Telegram profile snapshot only: it must
170 +             # never clobber the referral code or the balance, exactly like the
171 +             # ON CONFLICT clause in the real repository.
172 +             referral_code=existing.referral_code if existing else None,
173 +             bonus_balance=existing.bonus_balance if existing else 0,
174 +         )
175 +         self.items[user.telegram_id] = user
176 +         return user
177 +
178 +     async def count(self) -> int:
179 +         return len(self.items)
180 +
181 +     async def get_by_referral_code(self, code: str) -> User | None:
182 +         for user in self.items.values():
183 +             if user.referral_code == code:
184 +                 return user
185 +         return None
186 +
187 +     async def ensure_referral_code(self, telegram_id: int, *, candidate: str) -> str:
188 +         user = self.items.get(telegram_id)
189 +         if user is None:
190 +             raise UserNotFoundError(telegram_id=telegram_id)
191 +         if user.referral_code:
192 +             return user.referral_code
193 +         if await self.get_by_referral_code(candidate) is not None:
194 +             message = "This referral code is already taken"
195 +             raise ConflictError(message, candidate=candidate)
196 +         self.items[telegram_id] = replace(user, referral_code=candidate)
197 +         return candidate
198 +
199 +     def move_balance(self, telegram_id: int, delta: int) -> int:
200 +         """Apply a delta to the cached balance, refusing to go negative.
201 +
202 +         Mirrors ``ck_users_bonus_balance_non_negative``: the fake enforces the
203 +         constraint so a service test cannot pass by ignoring it.
204 +         """
205 +         user = self.items.get(telegram_id)
206 +         if user is None:
207 +             raise UserNotFoundError(telegram_id=telegram_id)
208 +         updated = user.bonus_balance + delta
209 +         if updated < 0:
210 +             raise InsufficientBonusBalanceError(user_id=telegram_id, requested=abs(delta))
211 +         self.items[telegram_id] = replace(user, bonus_balance=updated)
212 +         return updated

215 + class FakePurchaseRepository:
216 +     """Purchases in a dictionary, with the invoice and access rules enforced."""
217 +
218 +     def __init__(self) -> None:
219 +         self.items: dict[UUID, Purchase] = {}
220 +
221 +     async def create(self, draft: PurchaseDraft) -> Purchase:
222 +         for existing in self.items.values():
223 +             if existing.provider is draft.provider and existing.external_id == draft.external_id:
224 +                 message = "This invoice is already recorded"
225 +                 raise ConflictError(message, external_id=draft.external_id)
226 +         purchase = Purchase(
227 +             id=uuid4(),
228 +             user_id=draft.user_id,
229 +             product_id=draft.product_id,
230 +             provider=draft.provider,
231 +             status=draft.status or PurchaseStatus.PENDING,
232 +             amount=draft.amount,
233 +             base_amount=draft.base_amount,
234 +             discount_amount=draft.discount_amount,
235 +             bonus_amount=draft.bonus_amount,
236 +             currency=draft.currency,
237 +             external_id=draft.external_id,
238 +             telegram_charge_id=None,
239 +             delivered_url=None,
240 +             created_at=NOW,
241 +             paid_at=None,
242 +             delivered_at=None,
243 +         )
244 +         self.items[purchase.id] = purchase
245 +         return purchase
246 +
247 +     async def get(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> Purchase | None:
248 +         return self.items.get(purchase_id)
249 +
250 +     async def get_by_external_id(
251 +         self,
252 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
253 +         external_id: str,
254 +     ) -> Purchase | None:
255 +         for purchase in self.items.values():
256 +             if purchase.provider is provider and purchase.external_id == external_id:
257 +                 return purchase
258 +         return None
259 +
260 +     async def get_by_charge_id(self, telegram_charge_id: str) -> Purchase | None:
261 +         for purchase in self.items.values():
262 +             if purchase.telegram_charge_id == telegram_charge_id:
263 +                 return purchase
264 +         return None
265 +
266 +     async def find_access_granting(self, user_id: int, product_id: UUID) -> Purchase | None:
267 +         for purchase in self.items.values():
268 +             if (
269 +                 purchase.user_id == user_id
270 +                 and purchase.product_id == product_id
271 +                 and purchase.status in ACCESS_GRANTING_STATUSES
272 +             ):
273 +                 return purchase
274 +         return None
275 +
276 +     async def has_history(
277 +         self,
278 +         user_id: int,
279 +         *,
280 +         statuses: Sequence[PurchaseStatus],
281 +     ) -> bool:
282 +         return any(
283 +             purchase.user_id == user_id and purchase.status in statuses
284 +             for purchase in self.items.values()
285 +         )
286 +
287 +     async def has_pending_discount(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
288 +         return any(
289 +             purchase.user_id == user_id
290 +             and purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.PENDING
291 +             and purchase.discount_amount > 0
292 +             for purchase in self.items.values()
293 +         )
294 +
295 +     async def mark_paid(
296 +         self,
297 +         purchase_id: UUID,
298 +         *,
299 +         paid_at: datetime | None = None,
300 +         telegram_charge_id: str | None = None,
301 +     ) -> Purchase:
302 +         purchase = self._require(purchase_id)
303 +         if purchase.status in ACCESS_GRANTING_STATUSES:
304 +             return purchase
305 +         if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.REFUNDED:
306 +             message = "Refunded purchase cannot be paid again"
307 +             raise ConflictError(message, purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
308 +         owned = await self.find_access_granting(purchase.user_id, purchase.product_id)
309 +         if owned is not None:
310 +             raise DuplicatePurchaseError(purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
311 +         updated = replace(
312 +             purchase,
313 +             status=PurchaseStatus.PAID,
314 +             paid_at=paid_at or NOW,
315 +             telegram_charge_id=telegram_charge_id or purchase.telegram_charge_id,
316 +         )
317 +         self.items[purchase_id] = updated
318 +         return updated
319 +
320 +     async def mark_delivered(
321 +         self,
322 +         purchase_id: UUID,
323 +         *,
324 +         delivered_url: str,
325 +         delivered_at: datetime | None = None,
326 +     ) -> Purchase:
327 +         purchase = self._require(purchase_id)
328 +         if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED:
329 +             return purchase
330 +         if purchase.status is not PurchaseStatus.PAID:
331 +             message = "Only a paid purchase can be delivered"
332 +             raise ConflictError(message, purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
333 +         updated = replace(
334 +             purchase,
335 +             status=PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED,
336 +             delivered_url=delivered_url,
337 +             delivered_at=delivered_at or NOW,
338 +         )
339 +         self.items[purchase_id] = updated
340 +         return updated
341 +
342 +     async def mark_refunded(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> Purchase:
343 +         purchase = self._require(purchase_id)
344 +         updated = replace(purchase, status=PurchaseStatus.REFUNDED)
345 +         self.items[purchase_id] = updated
346 +         return updated
347 +
348 +     async def expire_pending(self, older_than: datetime) -> int:
349 +         expired = 0
350 +         for purchase_id, purchase in list(self.items.items()):
351 +             if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.PENDING and purchase.created_at < older_than:
352 +                 self.items[purchase_id] = replace(purchase, status=PurchaseStatus.EXPIRED)
353 +                 expired += 1
354 +         return expired
355 +
356 +     async def list_pending(
357 +         self,
358 +         provider: PaymentProvider,
359 +         *,
360 +         limit: int = 100,
361 +     ) -> tuple[Purchase, ...]:
362 +         pending = [
363 +             purchase
364 +             for purchase in self.items.values()
365 +             if purchase.provider is provider and purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.PENDING
366 +         ]
367 +         pending.sort(key=lambda purchase: purchase.created_at)
368 +         return tuple(pending[:limit])
369 +
370 +     async def search(self, filters: PurchaseFilters, page: PageRequest) -> Page[PurchaseRecord]:
371 +         del filters
372 +         return Page(items=(), total=0, limit=page.limit, offset=page.offset)
373 +
374 +     def _require(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> Purchase:
375 +         purchase = self.items.get(purchase_id)
376 +         if purchase is None:
377 +             raise PurchaseNotFoundError(purchase_id=str(purchase_id))
378 +         return purchase

381 + class FakeReferralRepository:
382 +     """Referrals in a dictionary, with the permanence rules enforced.
383 +
384 +     The two constraints the database carries are reproduced here on purpose: a
385 +     buyer has at most one referrer for life, and a discount is burned by at most
386 +     one purchase. A service test that violated either would fail here too.
387 +     """
388 +
389 +     def __init__(self) -> None:
390 +         self.items: dict[UUID, Referral] = {}
391 +         self.purchases: FakePurchaseRepository | None = None
392 +
393 +     async def create(self, draft: ReferralDraft) -> Referral:
394 +         if draft.referrer_user_id == draft.referred_user_id:
395 +             raise SelfReferralError(user_id=draft.referred_user_id)
396 +         if await self.get_by_referred(draft.referred_user_id) is not None:
397 +             raise ReferralAlreadySetError(referred_user_id=draft.referred_user_id)
398 +         referral = Referral(
399 +             id=uuid4(),
400 +             referrer_user_id=draft.referrer_user_id,
401 +             referred_user_id=draft.referred_user_id,
402 +             created_at=NOW,
403 +         )
404 +         self.items[referral.id] = referral
405 +         return referral
406 +
407 +     async def get(self, referral_id: UUID) -> Referral | None:
408 +         return self.items.get(referral_id)
409 +
410 +     async def get_by_referred(self, referred_user_id: int) -> Referral | None:
411 +         for referral in self.items.values():
412 +             if referral.referred_user_id == referred_user_id:
413 +                 return referral
414 +         return None
415 +
416 +     async def lock_for_discount_check(self, referred_user_id: int) -> Referral | None:
417 +         return await self.get_by_referred(referred_user_id)
418 +
419 +     async def mark_discount_used(
420 +         self,
421 +         referral_id: UUID,
422 +         *,
423 +         purchase_id: UUID,
424 +         used_at: datetime | None = None,
425 +     ) -> Referral:
426 +         referral = self.items.get(referral_id)
427 +         if referral is None:
428 +             raise ReferralNotFoundError(referral_id=str(referral_id))
429 +         if referral.discount_purchase_id is not None:
430 +             if referral.discount_purchase_id == purchase_id:
431 +                 return referral
432 +             raise DiscountAlreadyUsedError(referral_id=str(referral_id))
433 +         updated = replace(
434 +             referral,
435 +             discount_purchase_id=purchase_id,
436 +             discount_used_at=used_at or NOW,
437 +         )
438 +         self.items[referral_id] = updated
439 +         return updated
440 +
441 +     async def count_invited(self, referrer_user_id: int) -> int:
442 +         return sum(
443 +             1 for referral in self.items.values() if referral.referrer_user_id == referrer_user_id
444 +         )
445 +
446 +     async def count_referral_purchases(self, referrer_user_id: int) -> int:
447 +         if self.purchases is None:
448 +             return 0
449 +         invited = {
450 +             referral.referred_user_id
451 +             for referral in self.items.values()
452 +             if referral.referrer_user_id == referrer_user_id
453 +         }
454 +         return sum(
455 +             1
456 +             for purchase in self.purchases.items.values()
457 +             if purchase.user_id in invited and purchase.status in ACCESS_GRANTING_STATUSES
458 +         )
459 +
460 +     async def search(self, filters: ReferralFilters, page: PageRequest) -> Page[ReferralRecord]:
461 +         del filters
462 +         return Page(items=(), total=0, limit=page.limit, offset=page.offset)
463 +
464 +
465 + class FakeBonusRepository:
466 +     """A bonus ledger in a list, with the idempotency rules enforced.
467 +
468 +     ``(purchase_id, type)`` is unique here as well, which is what lets a test
469 +     replay a payment notification five times and assert one reward.
470 +     """
471 +
472 +     def __init__(self, users: FakeUserRepository) -> None:
473 +         self.entries: list[BonusTransaction] = []
474 +         self.users = users
475 +         self.purchases: FakePurchaseRepository | None = None
476 +
477 +     async def balance(self, user_id: int) -> int:
478 +         user = self.users.items.get(user_id)
479 +         return user.bonus_balance if user is not None else 0
480 +
481 +     async def lock_balance(self, user_id: int) -> int:
482 +         if user_id not in self.users.items:
483 +             raise UserNotFoundError(telegram_id=user_id)
484 +         return await self.balance(user_id)
485 +
486 +     async def add(self, draft: BonusTransactionDraft) -> BonusTransaction | None:
487 +         if draft.purchase_id is not None and any(
488 +             entry.purchase_id == draft.purchase_id and entry.type is draft.type
489 +             for entry in self.entries
490 +         ):
491 +             return None
492 +         self.users.move_balance(draft.user_id, draft.amount)
493 +         entry = BonusTransaction(
494 +             id=uuid4(),
495 +             user_id=draft.user_id,
496 +             amount=draft.amount,
497 +             type=draft.type,
498 +             referral_id=draft.referral_id,
499 +             purchase_id=draft.purchase_id,
500 +             stars_per_usdt=draft.stars_per_usdt,
501 +             created_at=NOW,
502 +         )
503 +         self.entries.append(entry)
504 +         return entry
505 +
506 +     async def find_for_purchase(
507 +         self,
508 +         purchase_id: UUID,
509 +         *types: BonusTransactionType,
510 +     ) -> BonusTransaction | None:
511 +         for entry in self.entries:
512 +             if entry.purchase_id == purchase_id and (not types or entry.type in types):
513 +                 return entry
514 +         return None
515 +
516 +     async def settle_hold(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> BonusTransaction | None:
517 +         for index, entry in enumerate(self.entries):
518 +             if entry.purchase_id == purchase_id and entry.type in BONUS_HOLD_TYPES:
519 +                 if entry.type is BonusTransactionType.BONUS_SPENT:
520 +                     return entry
521 +                 settled = replace(entry, type=BonusTransactionType.BONUS_SPENT)
522 +                 self.entries[index] = settled
523 +                 return settled
524 +         return None
525 +
526 +     async def release_hold(self, purchase_id: UUID) -> BonusTransaction | None:
527 +         held = await self.find_for_purchase(purchase_id, *BONUS_HOLD_TYPES)
528 +         if held is None or held.type is BonusTransactionType.BONUS_SPENT:
529 +             return None
530 +         return await self.add(
531 +             BonusTransactionDraft(
532 +                 user_id=held.user_id,
533 +                 amount=abs(held.amount),
534 +                 type=BonusTransactionType.BONUS_RESERVE_RELEASED,
535 +                 purchase_id=purchase_id,
536 +                 referral_id=held.referral_id,
537 +             )
538 +         )
539 +
540 +     async def recompute_balance(self, user_id: int) -> int:
541 +         return sum(entry.amount for entry in self.entries if entry.user_id == user_id)
542 +
543 +     async def reward_total(self, user_id: int) -> int:
544 +         return sum(
545 +             entry.amount
546 +             for entry in self.entries
547 +             if entry.user_id == user_id and entry.type is BonusTransactionType.REFERRAL_REWARD
548 +         )
549 +
550 +     async def purchases_awaiting_reward(self, *, limit: int = 100) -> tuple[UUID, ...]:
551 +         if self.purchases is None:
552 +             return ()
553 +         rewarded = {
554 +             entry.purchase_id
555 +             for entry in self.entries
556 +             if entry.type is BonusTransactionType.REFERRAL_REWARD
557 +         }
558 +         pending = [
559 +             purchase.id
560 +             for purchase in self.purchases.items.values()
561 +             if purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED and purchase.id not in rewarded
562 +         ]
563 +         return tuple(pending[:limit])
564 +
565 +     async def stale_holds(self, *, limit: int = 100) -> tuple[UUID, ...]:
566 +         if self.purchases is None:
567 +             return ()
568 +         dead = (PurchaseStatus.EXPIRED, PurchaseStatus.REFUNDED)
569 +         held = [
570 +             entry.purchase_id
571 +             for entry in self.entries
572 +             if entry.type is BonusTransactionType.BONUS_RESERVED
573 +             and entry.purchase_id is not None
574 +             and (purchase := self.purchases.items.get(entry.purchase_id)) is not None
575 +             and purchase.status in dead
576 +         ]
577 +         return tuple(item for item in held[:limit] if item is not None)
578 +

619 + class FakeUnitOfWork:
620 +     """One shared set of in-memory repositories."""
621 +
622 +     def __init__(self) -> None:
623 +         self._products = FakeProductRepository()
624 +         self._users = FakeUserRepository()
625 +         self._purchases = FakePurchaseRepository()
626 +         self._referrals = FakeReferralRepository()
627 +         self._bonuses = FakeBonusRepository(self._users)
628 +         self._stats = FakeStatsRepository()
629 +         self._products.purchases = self._purchases
630 +         self._referrals.purchases = self._purchases
631 +         self._bonuses.purchases = self._purchases
632 +         self.commits = 0
633 +         self.rollbacks = 0
634 +
635 +     @property
636 +     def products(self) -> FakeProductRepository:
637 +         return self._products
638 +
639 +     @property
640 +     def users(self) -> FakeUserRepository:
641 +         return self._users
642 +
643 +     @property
644 +     def purchases(self) -> FakePurchaseRepository:
645 +         return self._purchases
646 +
647 +     @property
648 +     def referrals(self) -> FakeReferralRepository:
649 +         return self._referrals
650 +
651 +     @property
652 +     def bonuses(self) -> FakeBonusRepository:
653 +         return self._bonuses
654 +
655 +     @property
656 +     def stats(self) -> FakeStatsRepository:
657 +         return self._stats
658 +
659 +     async def commit(self) -> None:
660 +         self.commits += 1
661 +
662 +     async def rollback(self) -> None:
663 +         self.rollbacks += 1

665 +
666 + class FakeUnitOfWorkFactory:
667 +     """Hands the same unit of work to every scope, counting the scopes."""
668 +
669 +     def __init__(self, unit: FakeUnitOfWork | None = None) -> None:
670 +         self.unit = unit or FakeUnitOfWork()
671 +         self.scopes = 0
672 +
673 +     @asynccontextmanager
674 +     async def __call__(self) -> AsyncIterator[FakeUnitOfWork]:
675 +         self.scopes += 1
676 +         try:
677 +             yield self.unit
678 +         except Exception:
679 +             await self.unit.rollback()
680 +             raise
681 +         await self.unit.commit()
682 +

684 + class FakeLockManager:
685 +     """In-memory locks that honour a TTL, using a monotonic clock."""
686 +
687 +     def __init__(self, *, clock: Any = monotonic) -> None:
688 +         self._clock = clock
689 +         self.held: dict[str, float] = {}
690 +         self.acquired: list[tuple[str, float | None]] = []
691 +         self.busy_keys: set[str] = set()
692 +
693 +     @asynccontextmanager
694 +     async def lock(
695 +         self,
696 +         key: str,
697 +         *,
698 +         ttl_seconds: float | None = None,
699 +         wait_seconds: float = 0.0,
700 +     ) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
701 +         del wait_seconds
702 +         expiry = self.held.get(key)
703 +         if key in self.busy_keys or (expiry is not None and expiry > self._clock()):
704 +             raise LockBusyError(lock_key=key)
705 +         self.acquired.append((key, ttl_seconds))
706 +         self.held[key] = self._clock() + (ttl_seconds or 45.0)
707 +         try:
708 +             yield
709 +         finally:
710 +             self.held.pop(key, None)
711 +

716 +     def __init__(self, failures: list[Exception] | None = None) -> None:
717 +         self.failures = list(failures or [])
718 +         self.sent: list[DeliveryMessage] = []
719 +
720 +     async def send(self, message: DeliveryMessage) -> None:
721 +         if self.failures:
722 +             raise self.failures.pop(0)
723 +         self.sent.append(message)

16  +     ("GET", "/products"),

24  + async def test_login_returns_tokens_and_sets_the_refresh_cookie(api: ApiHarness) -> None:
25  +     response = await api.client.post(
26  +         f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
27  +         json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD},
28  +     )
29  +
30  +     assert response.status_code == HTTPStatus.OK
31  +     body = response.json()
32  +     assert body["token_type"] == "bearer"  # noqa: S105
33  +     assert body["access_expires_in"] > 0
34  +     assert body["refresh_expires_in"] > body["access_expires_in"]
35  +
36  +     cookie = response.cookies.get(api.settings.security.cookie_name)
37  +     assert cookie == body["refresh_token"]
38  +     set_cookie = response.headers["set-cookie"].lower()
39  +     assert "httponly" in set_cookie
40  +     assert "samesite=strict" in set_cookie
41  +
42  +
43  + @pytest.mark.parametrize(
44  +     ("username", "password"),
45  +     [
46  +         (ADMIN_USERNAME, "wrong-password"),
47  +         ("intruder", ADMIN_PASSWORD),
48  +         (ADMIN_USERNAME.upper(), ADMIN_PASSWORD),
49  +     ],
50  + )
51  + async def test_wrong_credentials_are_rejected(
52  +     api: ApiHarness,
53  +     username: str,
54  +     password: str,
55  + ) -> None:
56  +     response = await api.client.post(
57  +         f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
58  +         json={"username": username, "password": password},
59  +     )
60  +     assert response.status_code == HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED
61  +     assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_credentials"
62  +
63  +
64  + async def test_login_is_rate_limited(api: ApiHarness) -> None:
65  +     """Credential guessing is slowed down per client and username."""
66  +     limit = api.settings.security.login_rate_limit
67  +     for _ in range(limit):
68  +         response = await api.client.post(
69  +             f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
70  +             json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"},
71  +         )
72  +         assert response.status_code == HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED
73  +
74  +     blocked = await api.client.post(
75  +         f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
76  +         json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD},
77  +     )
78  +     assert blocked.status_code == HTTPStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
79  +     assert blocked.json()["error"]["code"] == "too_many_attempts"
80  +
81  +
82  + async def test_a_successful_login_clears_the_attempt_counter(api: ApiHarness) -> None:
83  +     for _ in range(api.settings.security.login_rate_limit - 1):
84  +         await api.client.post(
85  +             f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
86  +             json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"},
87  +         )
88  +
89  +     assert (
90  +         await api.client.post(
91  +             f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
92  +             json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD},
93  +         )
94  +     ).status_code == HTTPStatus.OK
95  +     # The counter was reset, so a fresh series of attempts is allowed again.
96  +     assert (
97  +         await api.client.post(
98  +             f"{api.prefix}/auth/login",
99  +             json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": "wrong"},
100 +         )
101 +     ).status_code == HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED
102 +

144 +     login = await api.client.post(

146 +         json={"username": ADMIN_USERNAME, "password": ADMIN_PASSWORD},
147 +     )

149 +

161 +
162 +     # The new access token works.
163 +     me = await api.client.get(
164 +         f"{api.prefix}/auth/me",
165 +         headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {new_tokens['access_token']}"},
166 +     )
167 +     assert me.status_code == HTTPStatus.OK

182 +     )
183 +

185 +     assert response.status_code == HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT
186 +     assert not api.client.cookies.get(api.settings.security.cookie_name)
187 +
188 +     # A second logout is harmless, and the token is dead.
189 +     assert (await api.client.post(f"{api.prefix}/auth/logout")).status_code == HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT

31  +     return dict(response.json())

1   + """Admin API: statistics, purchase search, manual payment verification, re-delivery.
2   +
3   + The verification endpoint is the support tool for "I paid but got no link", so
4   + its idempotency is tested from every starting state.
5   + """
6   +
7   + from __future__ import annotations
8   +
9   + import json
10  + from decimal import Decimal
11  + from http import HTTPStatus
12  + from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
13  + from uuid import uuid4
14  +
15  + import httpx
16  + import pytest
17  + from sqlalchemy import text
18  +
19  + from app.domain.commands import ProductDraft, UserDraft
20  + from app.domain.enums import PaymentProvider, PurchaseStatus
21  + from tests.api_harness import api_settings, build_api_harness
22  +
23  + if TYPE_CHECKING:
24  +     from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
25  +
26  +     from redis.asyncio import Redis
27  +
28  +     from app.domain.entities import Product, Purchase
29  +     from app.infrastructure.cache.locks import RedisLockManager
30  +     from app.infrastructure.db.engine import Database
31  +     from tests.api_harness import ApiHarness
32  +
33  + BUYER = UserDraft(telegram_id=8001, username="buyer", first_name="Buyer", language_code="ru")
34  + DELIVERY_URL = "https://t.me/+private-invite"
35  + CRYPTO_INVOICE_ID = "551100"
36  +
37  +
38  + class CryptoPayDouble:
39  +     """A Crypto Pay stand-in whose invoice state the test controls."""
40  +
41  +     def __init__(self) -> None:
42  +         self.states: dict[str, str] = {}
43  +         self.calls = 0
44  +         self.unavailable = False
45  +
46  +     def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
47  +         self.calls += 1
48  +         if self.unavailable:
49  +             return httpx.Response(503, json={"ok": False, "error": "maintenance"})
50  +         payload = json.loads(request.content or b"{}")
51  +         requested = str(payload.get("invoice_ids", "")).split(",")
52  +         items = [
53  +             {"invoice_id": int(invoice_id), "status": self.states.get(invoice_id, "active")}
54  +             for invoice_id in requested
55  +             if invoice_id
56  +         ]
57  +         return httpx.Response(200, json={"ok": True, "result": {"items": items}})
58  +
59  +
60  + @pytest.fixture
61  + def crypto_double() -> CryptoPayDouble:
62  +     return CryptoPayDouble()
63  +
64  +
65  + @pytest.fixture
66  + async def verify_api(
67  +     live_database: Database,
68  +     live_locks: RedisLockManager,
69  +     redis_client: Redis,
70  +     migrated_database: str,
71  +     crypto_double: CryptoPayDouble,
72  + ) -> AsyncIterator[ApiHarness]:
73  +     """An authenticated admin client whose payment provider the test drives."""
74  +     settings = api_settings(migrated_database)
75  +     harness, client = build_api_harness(
76  +         settings=settings,
77  +         database=live_database,
78  +         locks=live_locks,
79  +         redis=redis_client,
80  +         crypto_transport=httpx.MockTransport(crypto_double.handler),
81  +     )
82  +     try:
83  +         await harness.authenticate()
84  +         yield harness
85  +     finally:
86  +         await client.aclose()
87  +         await harness.bot.session.close()
88  +
89  +
90  + async def _product(api: ApiHarness, **overrides: Any) -> Product:
91  +     values: dict[str, Any] = {
92  +         "slug": f"vip{uuid4().hex[:6]}",
93  +         "title": "VIP access",
94  +         "description": "Lifetime access",
95  +         "delivery_url": DELIVERY_URL,
96  +         "price_stars": 150,
97  +         "price_usdt": Decimal("5.00"),
98  +     }
99  +     values.update(overrides)
100 +     return await api.container.products.create(ProductDraft(**values))
101 +
102 +
103 + async def _pending(
104 +     api: ApiHarness,
105 +     product: Product,
106 +     *,
107 +     provider: PaymentProvider,
108 +     external_id: str,
109 + ) -> Purchase:
110 +     await api.container.purchases.remember_user(BUYER)
111 +     return await api.container.purchases.start_purchase(
112 +         user_id=BUYER.telegram_id,
113 +         product_id=product.id,
114 +         provider=provider,
115 +         external_id=external_id,
116 +     )
117 +
118 +
119 + async def _verify(api: ApiHarness, purchase: Purchase) -> dict[str, Any]:
120 +     response = await api.client.post(
121 +         f"{api.prefix}/purchases/{purchase.id}/verify",
122 +     )
123 +     assert response.status_code == HTTPStatus.OK, response.text
124 +     return dict(response.json())
125 +
126 +
127 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
128 + # Manual verification: CryptoBot
129 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
130 + async def test_verify_settles_a_crypto_payment_the_webhook_never_delivered(
131 +     verify_api: ApiHarness,
132 +     crypto_double: CryptoPayDouble,
133 + ) -> None:
134 +     """The support case: buyer paid in CryptoBot, the webhook was lost."""
135 +     product = await _product(verify_api)
136 +     purchase = await _pending(
137 +         verify_api,
138 +         product,
139 +         provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO,
140 +         external_id=CRYPTO_INVOICE_ID,
141 +     )
142 +     crypto_double.states[CRYPTO_INVOICE_ID] = "paid"
143 +
144 +     report = await _verify(verify_api, purchase)
145 +
146 +     assert report["outcome"] == "settled_and_delivered"
147 +     assert report["resolved"] is True
148 +     assert report["status_before"] == "pending"

106  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
107  + # Fake Crypto Pay
108  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
109  + class FakeCryptoPay:
110  +     """In-process Crypto Pay: records requests, serves scripted responses."""
111  +
112  +     def __init__(self) -> None:
113  +         self.created: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
114  +         self.states: dict[str, str] = {}
115  +         self.next_invoice_id = int(CRYPTO_INVOICE_ID)
116  +         self.fail_create = False
117  +
118  +     def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
119  +         payload = json.loads(request.content or b"{}")
120  +         if request.url.path.endswith("/createInvoice"):
121  +             if self.fail_create:
122  +                 return httpx.Response(500, json={"ok": False, "error": "server error"})
123  +             invoice_id = str(self.next_invoice_id)
124  +             self.next_invoice_id += 1
125  +             self.created.append(payload)
126  +             self.states[invoice_id] = "active"
127  +             return httpx.Response(
128  +                 200,
129  +                 json={
130  +                     "ok": True,
131  +                     "result": {
132  +                         "invoice_id": int(invoice_id),
133  +                         "status": "active",
134  +                         "bot_invoice_url": CRYPTO_PAY_URL,
135  +                     },
136  +                 },
137  +             )
138  +         if request.url.path.endswith("/getInvoices"):
139  +             requested = str(payload.get("invoice_ids", "")).split(",")
140  +             items = [
141  +                 {"invoice_id": int(invoice_id), "status": self.states.get(invoice_id, "active")}
142  +                 for invoice_id in requested
143  +                 if invoice_id
144  +             ]
145  +             return httpx.Response(200, json={"ok": True, "result": {"items": items}})
146  +         message = f"unexpected Crypto Pay call: {request.url.path}"
147  +         raise AssertionError(message)
148  +
149  +     def mark_paid(self, invoice_id: str) -> None:
150  +         self.states[invoice_id] = "paid"
151  +
152  +     def webhook_body(self, invoice_id: str) -> bytes:
153  +         return json.dumps(
154  +             {
155  +                 "update_id": 1,
156  +                 "update_type": "invoice_paid",
157  +                 "request_date": "2026-07-30T10:00:00Z",
158  +                 "payload": {"invoice_id": int(invoice_id), "status": "paid"},
159  +             }
160  +         ).encode()
161  +
162  +     @staticmethod
163  +     def sign(body: bytes) -> str:
164  +         secret = hashlib.sha256(CRYPTO_TOKEN.encode()).digest()
165  +         return hmac.new(secret, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
166  +
167  +
168  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
169  + # Harness
170  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
171  + @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
172  + class BotHarness:
173  +     """Everything a bot level test needs."""
174  +
175  +     bot: RecordingBot
176  +     dispatcher: Dispatcher
177  +     container: Container
178  +     checkout: CheckoutService
179  +     crypto: FakeCryptoPay
180  +     settings: Settings
181  +
182  +     async def feed(self, update: Any) -> None:
183  +         await self.dispatcher.feed_update(self.bot, update)
184  +
185  +
186  + def _settings(dsn: str, *, throttle: float = 0.0) -> Settings:
187  +     url = httpx.URL(dsn.replace("postgresql+asyncpg", "postgresql"))
188  +     return build_settings(
189  +         postgres=PostgresSettings(
190  +             host=url.host,
191  +             port=url.port or 5432,
192  +             user=url.username,
193  +             password=SecretStr(url.password),
194  +             db=url.path.lstrip("/"),
195  +         ),
196  +         redis=RedisSettings(host="127.0.0.1", lock_ttl_seconds=10.0),
197  +         telegram=TelegramSettings(
198  +             bot_token=SecretStr("123456789:AAHfake-Test-Token_for_unit_tests_only01"),
199  +             bot_username="MyShopBot",
200  +             use_webhook=False,
201  +             webhook_secret=SecretStr("webhook-secret-value"),
202  +         ),
203  +         cryptobot=CryptoBotSettings(api_token=SecretStr(CRYPTO_TOKEN), network="testnet"),
204  +         bot=BotSettings(throttle_seconds=throttle, reconciliation_batch_size=10),
205  +         delivery=DeliverySettings(max_attempts=3, initial_backoff_seconds=0.01),
206  +         security=SecuritySettings(
207  +             jwt_secret=SecretStr("a" * 48),
208  +             admin_username="administrator",
209  +             admin_password=SecretStr("super-secret-password"),
210  +         ),
211  +     )
212  +
213  +
214  + @pytest.fixture
215  + def crypto_pay() -> FakeCryptoPay:
216  +     return FakeCryptoPay()
217  +
218  +
219  + @pytest.fixture
220  + async def harness(
221  +     live_database: Database,
222  +     live_locks: RedisLockManager,
223  +     redis_client: Redis,
224  +     migrated_database: str,
225  +     crypto_pay: FakeCryptoPay,
226  + ) -> AsyncIterator[BotHarness]:
227  +     """A bot wired to the live database, live Redis and a fake Crypto Pay."""
228  +     settings = _settings(migrated_database)
229  +     container = _container(settings, live_database, live_locks, redis_client, crypto_pay)
230  +     bot = RecordingBot()
231  +     checkout = create_checkout(container, bot)
232  +     dispatcher = create_dispatcher(container, checkout)
233  +     try:
234  +         yield BotHarness(
235  +             bot=bot,
236  +             dispatcher=dispatcher,
237  +             container=container,
238  +             checkout=checkout,
239  +             crypto=crypto_pay,
240  +             settings=settings,
241  +         )
242  +     finally:
243  +         await bot.session.close()
244  +
245  +
246  + def _container(
247  +     settings: Settings,
248  +     database: Database,
249  +     locks: RedisLockManager,
250  +     redis: Redis,
251  +     crypto_pay: FakeCryptoPay,
252  + ) -> Container:
253  +     """A container using the live infrastructure and the fake payment provider."""
254  +     from app.infrastructure.db.uow import SqlAlchemyUnitOfWorkFactory  # noqa: PLC0415
255  +     from app.services.auth import AuthService  # noqa: PLC0415
256  +     from app.services.bonuses import BonusService  # noqa: PLC0415
257  +     from app.services.products import ProductService  # noqa: PLC0415
258  +     from app.services.purchases import PurchaseService  # noqa: PLC0415
259  +     from app.services.referrals import ReferralService  # noqa: PLC0415
260  +     from app.services.stats import StatsService  # noqa: PLC0415
261  +     from tests.fakes import FakeRevocationStore  # noqa: PLC0415
262  +
263  +     uow_factory = SqlAlchemyUnitOfWorkFactory(database)
264  +     crypto_client = CryptoBotClient(
265  +         settings.cryptobot,
266  +         client=httpx.AsyncClient(
267  +             base_url=settings.cryptobot.api_base_url,
268  +             transport=httpx.MockTransport(crypto_pay.handler),
269  +         ),
270  +     )
271  +     bonuses = BonusService(
272  +         uow_factory=uow_factory,
273  +         locks=locks,
274  +         settings=settings.referral,
275  +     )
276  +     return Container(
277  +         settings=settings,
278  +         uow_factory=uow_factory,
279  +         locks=locks,
280  +         rate_limiter=RedisRateLimiter(redis),
281  +         crypto_payments=crypto_client,
282  +         products=ProductService(uow_factory=uow_factory, telegram=settings.telegram),
283  +         purchases=PurchaseService(uow_factory=uow_factory, locks=locks, pricing=bonuses),
284  +         referrals=ReferralService(
285  +             uow_factory=uow_factory,
286  +             telegram=settings.telegram,
287  +             settings=settings.referral,
288  +         ),
289  +         bonuses=bonuses,
290  +         stats=StatsService(uow_factory=uow_factory),
291  +         auth=AuthService(settings.security, FakeRevocationStore()),
292  +     )
293  +
294  +
295  + async def _product(harness: BotHarness, **overrides: object) -> Product:
296  +     values: dict[str, object] = {
297  +         "slug": f"vip{uuid4().hex[:6]}",
298  +         "title": "VIP access",
299  +         "description": "Lifetime access",
300  +         "delivery_url": DELIVERY_URL,
301  +         "price_stars": STARS_PRICE,
302  +         "price_usdt": USDT_PRICE,
303  +     }
304  +     values.update(overrides)
305  +     return await harness.container.products.create(ProductDraft(**values))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
306  +

383  +     product = await _product(harness)
384  +     user = make_user()
385  +
386  +     await harness.feed(start_update(product.slug, user=user))
387  +     await harness.feed(
388  +         pay_button_update(provider=PaymentProvider.STARS, product_id=product.id, user=user)
389  +     )
390  +
391  +     invoices = harness.bot.methods(SendInvoice)
392  +     assert len(invoices) == 1
393  +     invoice = invoices[0]
394  +     assert invoice.currency == "XTR"
395  +     assert invoice.prices[0].amount == STARS_PRICE
396  +     payload = str(invoice.payload)
397  +
398  +     pending = await harness.container.purchases.list_pending(PaymentProvider.STARS)
399  +     assert len(pending) == 1
400  +     assert pending[0].external_id == payload
401  +     assert pending[0].status is PurchaseStatus.PENDING
402  +

405  +     answers = harness.bot.methods(AnswerPreCheckoutQuery)
406  +     assert [answer.ok for answer in answers] == [True]
407  +
408  +     # The payment lands: confirm, then deliver.
409  +     from tests.bot_harness import successful_payment_update  # noqa: PLC0415
410  +
411  +     await harness.feed(successful_payment_update(payload=payload, amount=STARS_PRICE, user=user))
412  +
413  +     settled = await harness.container.purchases.find_by_invoice(
414  +         provider=PaymentProvider.STARS,
415  +         external_id=payload,
416  +     )
417  +     assert settled is not None
418  +     assert settled.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED
419  +     assert settled.telegram_charge_id == "charge-1"
420  +     # The delivery is followed by a one-line referral invitation, so assert the
421  +     # link was handed over rather than that it was the very last message. This
422  +     # is the same style the repeat-delivery assertions in this file already use.
423  +     assert [text for text in harness.bot.texts() if DELIVERY_URL in text]
424  +
425  +     overview = await harness.container.stats.overview()
426  +     assert overview.total.purchases_count == 1
427  +     assert overview.total.stars_amount == STARS_PRICE

594  + async def test_a_lost_webhook_is_recovered_by_reconciliation(harness: BotHarness) -> None:
595  +     """No notification ever arrives: the poller must still deliver the purchase."""
596  +     product = await _product(harness)
597  +     user = make_user()
598  +     await harness.feed(start_update(product.slug, user=user))
599  +     await harness.feed(
600  +         pay_button_update(provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO, product_id=product.id, user=user)
601  +     )
602  +     invoice_id = (await harness.container.purchases.list_pending(PaymentProvider.CRYPTO))[
603  +         0
604  +     ].external_id
605  +
606  +     worker = ReconciliationWorker(
607  +         purchases=harness.container.purchases,
608  +         checkout=harness.checkout,
609  +         crypto=harness.container.crypto_payments,
610  +         settings=harness.settings.bot,
611  +     )
612  +     # Still unpaid at the provider: nothing happens.
613  +     assert await worker.run_once() == 0
614  +
615  +     harness.crypto.mark_paid(invoice_id)
616  +     assert await worker.run_once() == 1
617  +
618  +     purchase = await harness.container.purchases.find_by_invoice(
619  +         provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO,
620  +         external_id=invoice_id,
621  +     )
622  +     assert purchase is not None
623  +     assert purchase.status is PurchaseStatus.DELIVERED
624  +     # The delivery is followed by a one-line referral invitation, so assert the
625  +     # link was handed over rather than that it was the very last message. This
626  +     # is the same style the repeat-delivery assertions in this file already use.
627  +     assert [text for text in harness.bot.texts() if DELIVERY_URL in text]
628  +
629  +     # A second sweep must not deliver again.
630  +     assert await worker.run_once() == 0
631  +     assert len([text for text in harness.bot.texts() if DELIVERY_URL in text]) == 1

769  + async def test_many_buyers_purchase_in_parallel(harness: BotHarness) -> None:
770  +     """Twenty buyers, one product, no interference."""
771  +     from tests.bot_harness import successful_payment_update  # noqa: PLC0415
772  +
773  +     product = await _product(harness)
774  +     buyers = [make_user(telegram_id=5000 + index, username=f"buyer{index}") for index in range(20)]
775  +
776  +     await asyncio.gather(
777  +         *(
778  +             harness.feed(start_update(product.slug, user=buyer, update_id=100 + index))
779  +             for index, buyer in enumerate(buyers)
780  +         )
781  +     )
782  +     await asyncio.gather(
783  +         *(
784  +             harness.feed(
785  +                 pay_button_update(
786  +                     provider=PaymentProvider.STARS,
787  +                     product_id=product.id,
788  +                     user=buyer,
789  +                     update_id=200 + index,
790  +                 )
791  +             )
792  +             for index, buyer in enumerate(buyers)
793  +         )
794  +     )
795  +
796  +     invoices = harness.bot.methods(SendInvoice)
797  +     assert len(invoices) == len(buyers)
798  +
799  +     payload_by_chat = {int(invoice.chat_id): str(invoice.payload) for invoice in invoices}
800  +     await asyncio.gather(
801  +         *(
802  +             harness.feed(
803  +                 successful_payment_update(
804  +                     payload=payload_by_chat[buyer.id],
805  +                     amount=STARS_PRICE,
806  +                     charge_id=f"charge-{buyer.id}",
807  +                     user=buyer,
808  +                     update_id=300 + index,
809  +                 )
810  +             )
811  +             for index, buyer in enumerate(buyers)
812  +         )
813  +     )
814  +
815  +     overview = await harness.container.stats.overview()
816  +     assert overview.total.purchases_count == len(buyers)
817  +     assert overview.total.stars_amount == STARS_PRICE * len(buyers)
818  +     assert len([text for text in harness.bot.texts() if DELIVERY_URL in text]) == len(buyers)

948  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
949  + # Helpers
950  + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
951  + async def _webhook_client(harness: BotHarness) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
952  +     """An HTTP client wired straight into the aiohttp webhook application."""
953  +     app = web.Application()
954  +     register_cryptobot_webhook(
955  +         app,
956  +         path=harness.settings.cryptobot.webhook_path,
957  +         client=harness.container.crypto_payments,
958  +         checkout=harness.checkout,
959  +     )
960  +     transport = _AiohttpTransport(app)
961  +     return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://bot")
962  +
963  +
964  + class _AiohttpTransport(httpx.AsyncBaseTransport):
965  +     """Routes httpx requests into an aiohttp application without a socket."""
966  +
967  +     def __init__(self, app: web.Application) -> None:
968  +         self._app = app
969  +         self._handler_ready = False
970  +
971  +     async def handle_async_request(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
972  +         from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer  # noqa: PLC0415
973  +
974  +         server = TestServer(self._app)
975  +         client = TestClient(server)
976  +         await client.start_server()
977  +         try:
978  +             response = await client.request(
979  +                 request.method,
980  +                 request.url.path,
981  +                 data=request.content,
982  +                 headers=dict(request.headers),
983  +             )
984  +             body = await response.read()
985  +             return httpx.Response(response.status, content=body)
986  +         finally:
987  +             await client.close()
988  +

996  +     yield

1000 + async def test_the_throttle_middleware_lets_one_action_through_at_a_time(
1001 +     live_locks: RedisLockManager,
1002 + ) -> None:
1003 +     """Anti-flood is the same TTL bounded lock, so it always self-heals."""
1004 +     from app.bot.middlewares import ThrottleMiddleware  # noqa: PLC0415
1005 +     from tests.bot_harness import RecordingBot, make_message  # noqa: PLC0415
1006 +
1007 +     middleware = ThrottleMiddleware(live_locks, window_seconds=5.0)
1008 +     bot = RecordingBot()
1009 +     user = make_user(telegram_id=6001)
1010 +     started = asyncio.Event()
1011 +     release = asyncio.Event()
1012 +     handled = 0
1013 +
1014 +     async def handler(event: Any, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
1015 +         nonlocal handled
1016 +         del event, data
1017 +         handled += 1
1018 +         started.set()
1019 +         await release.wait()
1020 +         return "done"
1021 +
1022 +     message = make_message(text="hi", user=user).as_(bot)
1023 +     data = {"event_from_user": user}
1024 +
1025 +     try:
1026 +         first = asyncio.create_task(middleware(handler, message, data))
1027 +         await started.wait()
1028 +         # While the first action is in flight, the second is refused.
1029 +         second = await middleware(handler, message, data)
1030 +         assert second is None
1031 +         assert handled == 1
1032 +
1033 +         release.set()
1034 +         assert await first == "done"
1035 +
1036 +         # Once the first finished, the lock is free again.
1037 +         assert await middleware(handler, message, data) == "done"
1038 +         assert handled == 2
1039 +     finally:
1040 +         await bot.session.close()
1041 +
1042 +
1043 + async def test_a_throttled_buyer_is_told_to_slow_down(live_locks: RedisLockManager) -> None:
1044 +     from app.bot.middlewares import ThrottleMiddleware  # noqa: PLC0415
1045 +     from app.bot.texts import TOO_FAST  # noqa: PLC0415
1046 +     from tests.bot_harness import RecordingBot, make_message  # noqa: PLC0415
1047 +
1048 +     middleware = ThrottleMiddleware(live_locks, window_seconds=5.0)
1049 +     user = make_user(telegram_id=6002)
1050 +     bot = RecordingBot()
1051 +     data = {"event_from_user": user}
1052 +
1053 +     async def slow(event: Any, inner: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1054 +         del event, inner
1055 +         await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
1056 +
1057 +     message = make_message(text="hi", user=user).as_(bot)
1058 +     try:
1059 +         task = asyncio.create_task(middleware(slow, message, data))
1060 +         await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

1062 +         await task
1063 +         assert TOO_FAST in bot.texts()
1064 +     finally:
1065 +         await bot.session.close()

1068 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
1069 + # The webhook server as the container runs it
1070 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
1071 + async def test_the_webhook_server_serves_every_route_and_shuts_down_on_request(
1072 +     harness: BotHarness,
1073 + ) -> None:
1074 +     """The production transport, end to end: bind, serve, stop, release the port.
1075 +
1076 +     Covers what the container depends on and nothing else can prove: the liveness
1077 +     route answers, both provider routes exist and reject unauthenticated calls,
1078 +     and a shutdown request actually ends the process instead of leaving the port
1079 +     held.
1080 +     """
1081 +     from app.bot.runner import BotRuntime, run_webhook  # noqa: PLC0415
1082 +     from app.bot.webhooks import HEALTH_PATH  # noqa: PLC0415
1083 +
1084 +     with socket.socket() as probe:
1085 +         probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
1086 +         port = probe.getsockname()[1]
1087 +
1088 +     settings = harness.settings.model_copy(
1089 +         update={
1090 +             "telegram": TelegramSettings(
1091 +                 bot_token=SecretStr("123456789:AAHfake-Test-Token_for_unit_tests_only01"),
1092 +                 bot_username="MyShopBot",
1093 +                 use_webhook=True,
1094 +                 webhook_base_url="https://shop.example.com",
1095 +                 webhook_secret=SecretStr("webhook-secret-value"),
1096 +                 drop_pending_updates=True,
1097 +             ),
1098 +             "bot": BotSettings(throttle_seconds=0.0, webhook_port=port),
1099 +         },
1100 +     )
1101 +
1102 +     runtime = BotRuntime(
1103 +         settings=settings,
1104 +         container=harness.container,
1105 +         bot=harness.bot,
1106 +         dispatcher=harness.dispatcher,
1107 +         checkout=harness.checkout,
1108 +     )
1109 +     stop = asyncio.Event()
1110 +     server = asyncio.create_task(run_webhook(runtime, stop))
1111 +     base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
1112 +     try:
1113 +         async with asyncio.timeout(10):
1114 +             await _wait_until_listening(port)
1115 +
1116 +         async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=base, timeout=5.0) as client:
1117 +             liveness = await client.get(HEALTH_PATH)
1118 +             assert liveness.status_code == 200
1119 +             assert liveness.json()["status"] == "alive"
1120 +
1121 +             # Registered, and closed to anyone without the secret token.
1122 +             unauthorised = await client.post(
1123 +                 settings.telegram.webhook_path,
1124 +                 json={"update_id": 1},
1125 +             )
1126 +             assert unauthorised.status_code == 401
1127 +
1128 +             # Registered, and closed to anyone without a valid signature.
1129 +             unsigned = await client.post(
1130 +                 settings.cryptobot.webhook_path,
1131 +                 json={"update_type": "invoice_paid"},
1132 +             )
1133 +             assert unsigned.status_code == 401
1134 +
1135 +         stop.set()
1136 +         await asyncio.wait_for(server, timeout=10)
1137 +     finally:
1138 +         if not server.done():
1139 +             server.cancel()
1140 +             with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
1141 +                 await server
1142 +
1143 +     # The port is free again, so a restart cannot fail on "address in use".
1144 +     with socket.socket() as rebind:
1145 +         rebind.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
1146 +         rebind.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
1147 +
1148 +
1149 + async def _wait_until_listening(port: int) -> None:
1150 +     """Wait for the webhook server to accept connections."""
1151 +     while True:
1152 +         try:
1153 +             _, writer = await asyncio.open_connection("127.0.0.1", port)
1154 +         except OSError:
1155 +             await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
1156 +             continue
1157 +         writer.close()
1158 +         with suppress(ConnectionError):
1159 +             await writer.wait_closed()
1160 +         return
1161 +
1162 +
1163 + async def test_long_polling_stops_when_the_process_is_asked_to(harness: BotHarness) -> None:
1164 +     """Ctrl+C locally, SIGTERM in a container: both must end the polling loop.
1165 +
1166 +     Without this, `stop_polling` would never be called and the process would hang
1167 +     until it was killed, skipping every cleanup path.
1168 +     """
1169 +     from app.bot.runner import BotRuntime, run_polling  # noqa: PLC0415
1170 +
1171 +     runtime = BotRuntime(
1172 +         settings=harness.settings,
1173 +         container=harness.container,
1174 +         bot=harness.bot,
1175 +         dispatcher=harness.dispatcher,
1176 +         checkout=harness.checkout,
1177 +     )
1178 +     stop = asyncio.Event()
1179 +     polling = asyncio.create_task(run_polling(runtime, stop))
1180 +     try:
1181 +         # Give the loop time to reach getUpdates before asking it to stop.
1182 +         await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
1183 +         assert not polling.done()
1184 +
1185 +         stop.set()
1186 +         async with asyncio.timeout(10):
1187 +             await polling
1188 +     finally:
1189 +         if not polling.done():
1190 +             polling.cancel()
1191 +             with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
1192 +                 await polling
1193 +

1195 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
1196 + # A link that turned out to be broken
1197 + # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
1198 + async def test_a_rotated_link_is_what_a_re_delivery_sends(harness: BotHarness) -> None:
1199 +     """The buyer always receives the link the product carries *now*.
1200 +
1201 +     The support case behind this: the buyer paid with Stars, the link was dead,
1202 +     and the next day the administrator fixed the product and pressed «Отправить
1203 +     ссылку». Sending the snapshot taken at the moment of the sale would hand the
1204 +     dead link over a second time, so delivery reads the product instead.
1205 +     """
1206 +     from app.domain.commands import ProductUpdate  # noqa: PLC0415
1207 +     from tests.bot_harness import successful_payment_update  # noqa: PLC0415
1208 +
1209 +     broken = "https://example.com/broken-invite"
1210 +     working = "https://example.com/working-invite"
1211 +
1212 +     product = await _product(harness, delivery_url=broken)
1213 +     user = make_user()
1214 +     await harness.feed(start_update(product.slug, user=user))
1215 +     await harness.feed(
1216 +         pay_button_update(provider=PaymentProvider.STARS, product_id=product.id, user=user)
1217 +     )
1218 +     payload = await _stars_payload(harness)
1219 +     await harness.feed(successful_payment_update(payload=payload, amount=STARS_PRICE, user=user))
1220 +
1221 +     assert any(broken in text for text in harness.bot.texts())
1222 +
1223 +     # The administrator fixes the product the next day.
1224 +     await harness.container.products.update(
1225 +         product.id,
1226 +         ProductUpdate(delivery_url=working),
1227 +     )
1228 +
1229 +     # …and presses «Отправить ссылку» in the panel.
1230 +     owned = await harness.container.purchases.find_owned(user.id, product.id)
1231 +     assert owned is not None
1232 +     result = await harness.checkout.redeliver(owned.id)
1233 +
1234 +     assert result.succeeded
1235 +     assert working in harness.bot.last_text()
1236 +     # The dead link is never sent again, by any path.
1237 +     assert sum(broken in text for text in harness.bot.texts()) == 1
1238 +
1239 +     # The buyer opening the deep link again also gets the working one.
1240 +     await harness.feed(start_update(product.slug, user=user, update_id=77))
1241 +     assert working in harness.bot.last_text()
1242 +     assert sum(working in text for text in harness.bot.texts()) == 2
1243 +
1244 +     # No second charge for any of it.
1245 +     overview = await harness.container.stats.overview()
1246 +     assert overview.total.purchases_count == 1
1247 +

1427 + ) -> None:
1428 +     """The regression that reached production, driven the way a buyer hits it.
1429 +
1430 +     The card offered 4.50, but the CryptoBot invoice was raised at the list
1431 +     5.00, and ``start_purchase`` then refused to record a purchase at a price
1432 +     other than the invoiced one. The buyer saw only "не удалось создать счёт на
1433 +     оплату" and could not buy anything at all with crypto while their discount
1434 +     was unspent.

1437 +     Stars invoice is created *after* the purchase, so there are never two
1438 +     numbers to disagree.
1439 +     """

1447 +     await harness.feed(
1448 +         pay_button_update(
1449 +             provider=PaymentProvider.CRYPTO,
1450 +             product_id=product.id,
1451 +             user=invited,
1452 +             update_id=142,
1453 +         )
1454 +     )

1458 +     assert PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE not in alerts
1459 +     assert CRYPTO_INVOICE_CREATED in harness.bot.texts()

1468 +     assert pending[0].amount == Decimal("4.50")
1469 +     assert pending[0].base_amount == Decimal("5.00")
1470 +     assert pending[0].discount_amount == Decimal("0.50")

1   + """Runtime behaviour of the bot process: liveness route and graceful shutdown.
2   +
3   + These are the pieces a container runtime interacts with. They are tested here
4   + without a database, because neither of them may depend on one: a liveness probe
5   + that fails during a PostgreSQL outage would turn a dependency blip into a restart
6   + loop, and a shutdown path that needed the database could not run while it is down.
7   + """
8   +
9   + from __future__ import annotations
10  +
11  + import asyncio
12  + import os
13  + import signal
14  + from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
15  +
16  + import pytest
17  + from aiohttp import web
18  + from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
19  +
20  + from app import __version__
21  + from app.bot.runner import _install_signal_handlers, _wait_for_shutdown
22  + from app.bot.webhooks import HEALTH_PATH, register_health_route
23  +
24  + if TYPE_CHECKING:
25  +     from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
26  +
27  +
28  + @pytest.fixture
29  + async def health_client() -> AsyncIterator[TestClient[web.Request, web.Application]]:
30  +     """A client wired straight into an application with only the health route."""
31  +     app = web.Application()
32  +     register_health_route(app)
33  +     client: TestClient[web.Request, web.Application] = TestClient(TestServer(app))
34  +     await client.start_server()
35  +     try:
36  +         yield client
37  +     finally:
38  +         await client.close()
39  +
40  +
41  + async def test_the_liveness_route_reports_the_running_version(
42  +     health_client: TestClient[web.Request, web.Application],
43  + ) -> None:
44  +     """The container healthcheck must get a cheap, unambiguous answer."""
45  +     response = await health_client.get(HEALTH_PATH)
46  +
47  +     assert response.status == 200
48  +     assert await response.json() == {"status": "alive", "version": __version__}
49  +
50  +
51  + async def test_the_liveness_route_is_read_only(
52  +     health_client: TestClient[web.Request, web.Application],
53  + ) -> None:
54  +     """Nothing may be triggered by probing liveness."""
55  +     response = await health_client.post(HEALTH_PATH)
56  +
57  +     assert response.status == 405
58  +
59  +

61  +     """It must never collide with a provider route nginx forwards."""
62  +     assert not HEALTH_PATH.startswith("/webhook/")
63  +
64  +
65  + async def test_sigterm_asks_the_process_to_stop() -> None:
66  +     """A container stop must reach the shutdown path, not kill the process."""
67  +     stop = asyncio.Event()
68  +     _install_signal_handlers(stop)
69  +     try:
70  +         os.kill(os.getpid(), signal.SIGTERM)
71  +         await asyncio.wait_for(stop.wait(), timeout=2)
72  +     finally:
73  +         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
74  +         loop.remove_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM)
75  +         loop.remove_signal_handler(signal.SIGINT)
76  +
77  +     assert stop.is_set()
78  +
79  +
80  + async def test_shutdown_returns_while_the_transport_is_still_serving() -> None:
81  +     """The waiter reacts to the signal; stopping the transport is the caller's job."""
82  +     stop = asyncio.Event()
83  +     transport = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.sleep(30))
84  +
85  +     stop.set()
86  +     await asyncio.wait_for(_wait_for_shutdown(stop, transport), timeout=2)
87  +
88  +     assert not transport.done()
89  +     transport.cancel()
90  +

93  +     """A webhook server that dies must not be mistaken for a clean shutdown."""
94  +
95  +     async def explode() -> None:
96  +         msg = "port already in use"
97  +         raise OSError(msg)
98  +
99  +     stop = asyncio.Event()
100 +     transport = asyncio.create_task(explode())
101 +
102 +     with pytest.raises(OSError, match="port already in use"):
103 +         await asyncio.wait_for(_wait_for_shutdown(stop, transport), timeout=2)
104 +

106 + async def test_a_transport_that_finishes_on_its_own_ends_the_wait() -> None:
107 +     """Long polling that stops by itself must not hang the process."""
108 +

110 +         return
111 +
112 +     stop = asyncio.Event()

114 +

1   + """The concrete repositories must satisfy the domain contracts.
2   +
3   + Assigning each implementation to its ``Protocol`` type makes mypy verify the
4   + whole signature — argument names, keyword-only markers and return types — so a
5   + drift between contract and implementation fails the type check, not production.
6   + The runtime assertions below guard against a method disappearing entirely.
7   + """
8   +
9   + from __future__ import annotations
10  +
11  + import inspect
12  + from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
13  +
14  + from app.domain.repositories import (
15  +     BonusRepository,
16  +     ProductRepository,
17  +     PurchaseRepository,
18  +     ReferralRepository,
19  +     StatsRepository,
20  +     UserRepository,
21  + )
22  +
23  + if TYPE_CHECKING:
24  +     # Only referenced from annotations: the conformance helpers below exist for
25  +     # mypy, not for the interpreter.
26  +     from app.domain.auth import TokenRevocationStore
27  +     from app.domain.bonuses import CheckoutPricing, SaleCompletion
28  +     from app.domain.delivery import DeliveryGateway
29  +     from app.domain.locks import LockManager
30  +     from app.domain.notifications import RewardNotifier
31  +     from app.domain.uow import UnitOfWork, UnitOfWorkFactory
32  +     from app.infrastructure.cache.locks import RedisLockManager
33  +     from app.infrastructure.cache.revocation import RedisTokenRevocationStore
34  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.bonuses import SqlAlchemyBonusRepository
35  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.products import SqlAlchemyProductRepository
36  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.purchases import SqlAlchemyPurchaseRepository
37  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.referrals import SqlAlchemyReferralRepository
38  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.stats import SqlAlchemyStatsRepository
39  +     from app.infrastructure.db.repositories.users import SqlAlchemyUserRepository
40  +     from app.infrastructure.db.uow import SqlAlchemyUnitOfWork, SqlAlchemyUnitOfWorkFactory
41  +     from app.infrastructure.telegram.notifications import TelegramBonusNotifier
42  +     from app.services.bonuses import BonusService
43  +     from tests.fakes import (
44  +         FakeBonusRepository,
45  +         FakeDeliveryGateway,
46  +         FakeLockManager,
47  +         FakeReferralRepository,
48  +         FakeUnitOfWorkFactory,
49  +     )
50  +
51  +
52  + def _protocol_methods(protocol: type) -> set[str]:
53  +     return {
54  +         name
55  +         for name in vars(protocol)
56  +         if not name.startswith("_") and callable(getattr(protocol, name, None))
57  +     }
58  +
59  +
60  + def test_product_repository_satisfies_the_contract(
61  +     products: SqlAlchemyProductRepository,
62  + ) -> None:
63  +     contract: ProductRepository = products
64  +     assert _protocol_methods(ProductRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
65  +
66  +
67  + def test_user_repository_satisfies_the_contract(users: SqlAlchemyUserRepository) -> None:
68  +     contract: UserRepository = users
69  +     assert _protocol_methods(UserRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
70  +
71  +
72  + def test_purchase_repository_satisfies_the_contract(
73  +     purchases: SqlAlchemyPurchaseRepository,
74  + ) -> None:
75  +     contract: PurchaseRepository = purchases
76  +     assert _protocol_methods(PurchaseRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
77  +
78  +
79  + def test_stats_repository_satisfies_the_contract(stats: SqlAlchemyStatsRepository) -> None:
80  +     contract: StatsRepository = stats
81  +     assert _protocol_methods(StatsRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
82  +
83  +
84  + def test_contracts_are_fully_annotated() -> None:
85  +     """No repository method may hide an untyped argument or return value.
86  +
87  +     Annotations are read as written (not resolved): the contract module keeps its
88  +     entity imports inside ``TYPE_CHECKING``, which is exactly the point.
89  +     """
90  +     for protocol in (ProductRepository, UserRepository, PurchaseRepository, StatsRepository):
91  +         for name in _protocol_methods(protocol):
92  +             method = getattr(protocol, name)
93  +             annotations = method.__annotations__
94  +             signature = inspect.signature(method)
95  +             assert "return" in annotations, f"{protocol.__name__}.{name} lacks a return type"
96  +             for parameter in signature.parameters.values():
97  +                 if parameter.name == "self":
98  +                     continue
99  +                 assert parameter.name in annotations, (
100 +                     f"{protocol.__name__}.{name}({parameter.name}) is not annotated"
101 +                 )
102 +
103 +
104 + def test_referral_repository_satisfies_the_contract(
105 +     referrals: SqlAlchemyReferralRepository,
106 + ) -> None:
107 +     contract: ReferralRepository = referrals
108 +     assert _protocol_methods(ReferralRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
109 +
110 +
111 + def test_bonus_repository_satisfies_the_contract(
112 +     bonuses: SqlAlchemyBonusRepository,
113 + ) -> None:
114 +     contract: BonusRepository = bonuses
115 +     assert _protocol_methods(BonusRepository) <= set(dir(contract))
116 +
